news.drawTailAway: Quiet the crowd early and anything is possible.
news.finalsWeekend: {venue} stages both European finals this season: the Continental Shield under Friday lights, the Continental Cup on the Saturday. {seats} seats in {city}, the whole sport in town. Eight quarter-finalists stand in each, and all circled the date this morning.
news.finalsWeekend_f: {venue} stages the Hemispheric Championship final this season. {seats} seats in {city}, the whole sport in town. Eight quarter-finalists stand, and all circled the date this morning.
news.natFilled: Kick-off was coming and the squad was short, so your assistant added {n} to make up the numbers. They are named on merit, not on your judgement - next window, name it yourself.
news.natName: The camp is open and the sheet is blank. {nationCap_k} need a squad named before the first Test - at least {n} of them - and the country desk has everyone available, with the coaches' picks at the top. This one is yours: nobody is going to name it for you.
news.lionsCallA:
The call every player in these islands dreams of: {names} {is_k} going on {tour}. The whole club walks taller this morning.
{he_k} will be away for the tour window. Plan the run-in accordingly. And welcome back a tourist.
news.lionsCallB:
The {tour} squad is out, and the club's name is on it: {names}. Training stopped for the announcement. Nobody minded.
{he_k} will be away for the tour window. Plan the run-in accordingly. And welcome back a tourist.
news.callUps: The following players have been called up and will be unavailable during the international window: {names}.
news.lionsHome: Back in club colours after {tour}: {names}. Win or lose, a tour changes a player - {come_k} back a bigger presence in this dressing room. The medical staff still counsel care: a tour summer empties the tank like nothing else.
news.lionsHomeWonSubj: The tourists come home as series winners
news.lionsHomeWon: Back in club colours after {tour}: {names}. A series win in the luggage, and the kind of standing money cannot buy. Expect {him_k} to walk taller here too. The medical staff still counsel care: a tour summer empties the tank like nothing else.
news.intlBack: Back in club colours: {names}. The medical staff's advice is blunt: Test rugby empties the tank, and none of them are at full freshness this week. Rotate or risk it - your call.
news.mentorLost: With {mentor} gone, {kid} is training alone again. The academy coach will keep an eye on him, but it isn't the same.

wantsTerms.one: {player}'s agent has been on the phone: his client is playing out of his skin (avg {avg}) on {wage}/week, and the market rate is well north of that. He has {n} year left, but leave it unresolved and his head will drop - and other clubs will smell it.
wantsTerms.other: {player}'s agent has been on the phone: his client is playing out of his skin (avg {avg}) on {wage}/week, and the market rate is well north of that. He has {n} years left, but leave it unresolved and his head will drop - and other clubs will smell it.

news.agentPublic: Two months of silence from the club, so the agent has taken it to the papers: "{player} is one of the best-performing players in the league and the club knows our position." Rival clubs will have noticed. Sort a new deal, or brace for bids.
news.becomesMentor: The coaches have noticed it in the little things - the extras after training, the way he talks in the huddle. {player} is starting to carry himself like {mentor}.
news.mentorStart: The old pro and the academy kid: {mentor} will mentor {player} for the season. Extras after training, lifts to the ground, the lot. This is how clubs pass themselves on.
news.aheadOfSchedule: Good news from the treatment table: {player} ({injury_k}) has smashed his rehab targets and is available again this week, earlier than anyone dared hope.
news.backInTraining: Available for selection again: {men_l}. Pick a rusty player now and the body can break down again; ease them back and they will be right.
news.backInTrainingV2: The physios have signed off: {men_l}. Fit is not the same as sharp, so the first game back is a risk you choose to take or not.
news.backInTrainingV3: Back with the main group this week: {men_l}. The medical staff want the minutes built up rather than handed over in one go.
news.wPeaceBrokered: The manager got them in a room and shut the door. Both men came out and trained. Nobody is pretending they are friends, but the squad can get on with its week.
news.wTalksFail: The manager tried to settle it between {a} and {b} and got nowhere. Worse, the squad knows the meeting happened, and that it did not work.
news.wPeace1: Clear-the-air talks at the training ground this week. {a} and {b} trained together on Thursday and the squad say the atmosphere has lifted. One senior player: "It's done. We move."
news.wPeace2: Whatever was said between {a} and {b}, it worked: the pair ran the same drills all week and shared a bench at lunch. The squad has quietly exhaled.
news.wPeace3: {a} and {b} shook hands in front of the group on Monday, which is how these things end in rugby: no statement, no ceremony, back to work.
news.wFrosty1: Sources close to the squad say {a} and {b} are still not speaking. Team-mates are starting to pick sides, the sort of thing that costs points.
news.wFrosty2: {a} and {b} warmed up at opposite ends of the pitch again this week. The coaches pretend not to notice. The players notice everything.
news.wFrosty3: No thaw yet between {a} and {b}: separate gym slots, separate tables, one very tired captain shuttling between them.
news.wRift: The Wire understands {a} and {b} had {flash_k}. Coaches separated the pair. Expect the mood to suffer until it's resolved. Keep winning and these things heal quicker.
news.wCommunity1: The whole squad spent Wednesday coaching at local schools and visiting the children's ward. Corny? Maybe. But the group came back closer, and the town noticed.
news.wCommunity2: School visits, hospital wards, a hundred wonky selfies: the squad gave the town its Wednesday. The bus home was loud in the good way.
news.wBoot1: {player} has signed a personal sponsorship with a boot manufacturer. His locker now contains fourteen boxes of boots and one very smug grin.
news.wBoot2: A boot brand has put {player} on a personal deal. The first shipment arrived in club colours; the second, mysteriously, in gold. The forwards have thoughts.
news.wGround1: The head groundsman has banned the forwards from 'his' pitch until Thursday after last week's scrummaging session left it looking ploughed. The pack are training on the back field, muttering.
news.wGround2: An uneasy truce at {stadium}: the groundsman has chalked a line beyond which "no scrummaging shall occur". The pack are testing its legal force one metre at a time.
news.wAdvert1: {player} spent his day off filming a regional car dealership advert. Team-mates have already obtained the script. Training may include dramatic readings.
news.wAdvert2: {player} is the new face of a local bathroom showroom. The billboard goes up next month. The dressing room has already ordered a framed print for his locker.
news.wChef1: The performance department has brought in {chef_k} for the rest of the season. The senior pros are sceptical. The young lads are all-in. Someone has already broken the new equipment.
news.wChef2: {short} have added {chef_k} to the backroom staff. Week one verdict from the front row: "interesting". Week one verdict from the academy: total religious conversion.
news.wBug1: The medical room is standing-room only: {names} have all been laid low by a virus doing the rounds. They'll play if picked, but the tanks won't be full this week. The kit staff are bleaching everything.
news.wBug2: {names} all called in pale and shivering this week. The doctor's diagnosis: "the thing that's going round." They can play, but do not expect eighty full-blooded minutes.
news.wBug3: A virus has worked through the squad faster than any defensive drill: {names} are all below par. Training moved outdoors, soup was served, and the physio room smells of eucalyptus.
news.wTakeoverHardens: The consortium linked with {club} has reportedly entered exclusivity. Due diligence is under way; the current owners are said to be "open to the right offer". Supporters dare to dream of a war chest.
news.wTakeoverOff: After weeks of whispers, the money men have walked away from {club} - "valuation gap", say sources. The club statement thanks supporters for their patience and says it remains "well capitalised". Nobody is convinced.
news.wTakeoverCircle: A wealthy consortium - the names change depending on who you ask - has been linked with a takeover of {club}. A private jet at the local airfield has done a lot of heavy lifting in the fan forums. Most of these stories die quietly; some don't.
news.wRumour1: {buyerName} have sent scouts to {ownerPoss} last three matches - the man they're watching is {player}.
news.wRumour2: Agents claim {buyer} are readying a {fee} bid for {player}. {owner} insist he is going nowhere.
news.wRumour3: {player} to {buyer}? A source at the player's management agency says "there is interest, and it's serious."
news.wRumour4: Whispers from {buyerCity}: {buyerPoss} head coach has made {player} their number one target.
news.wAgent1: {player} is out of contract at the end of the season and the agent is doing the media rounds: "My client loves the club, but wants to feel loved back. We are listening to what's out there." Sort a new deal - or cash in.
news.wAgent2: Six months left on {player}'s deal and his agent has started answering the phone on the first ring. "No comment" has never carried so much comment. Renew him or price him.
news.wAgent3: The contract clock is ticking on {player}, and this week his agent was photographed at lunch with two directors of rugby who were not yours. Draw your own conclusions. Everyone else has.
news.grForumExitSubj: FAN FORUM: "{starLast} to leave?" thread hits 400 replies in a night
news.grForumExit: One unsourced post claiming {star} has "told friends he wants out" has produced four hundred replies, two spin-off threads and a poll. There is no agent, no journalist and no evidence. Page nine is arguing about the stadium car park. One moderator: "Every year. Same thread. Same fella posting it."
news.grSocialClipSubj: SOCIAL: eleven seconds of {star} in training breaks containment
news.grSocialClip: Two million views and counting for a clip of {star} doing something that should not be physically available to a man that size. The comments are split between awe and accusations of a smaller pitch. {shortPoss} media team have posted it, deleted it, and posted it again with worse music.
news.grPodcastKebabSubj: PODCAST: {star}'s cheat meal confession divides the nation
news.grPodcastKebab: Forty minutes of genuinely excellent lineout detail earned nothing. One sentence about a Friday kebab has produced eight hundred quote tweets and a statement from a rival takeaway offering him a sponsorship. The {short} nutritionist has requested a right of reply and has been told the slot is full.
news.grAiGraphicSubj: BROADCAST: graphics package gives {starLast} six fingers and a new name
news.grAiGraphic: The pre-match player card rendered {star} with an extra finger, a surname spelled two different ways in the same graphic, and a career-tries figure that would make him the leading scorer in the sport's history. The broadcaster has apologised. The screenshot is already a profile picture.
news.grStatAccountSubj: STATS ACCOUNT: {short} are top of a table nobody asked for
news.grStatAccount: A popular numbers account has crunched carries into contact per phase in the opposition 22 on grounds above sea level and declared {short} the best team in the league. Fans of {short} have adopted the metric as gospel. Everyone else has pointed out that it also ranks a pub side above the world champions.
news.grPunditGemSubj: PUNDIT COLUMN: "{short} have unearthed a gem"
news.grPunditGem: This week's big read calls {kid}, {kidAge}, "the most natural {kidPos} of his generation" and notes that half the league already knows. {short} supporters have spent the day politely asking the columnist to be quiet, delete it, and consider a career in something else. The columnist has replied to eleven of them individually. He is enjoying this enormously.
news.grSchoolVisitSubj: WHOLESOME: {kid} shows up to a school assembly and stays two hours
news.grSchoolVisit: A local primary asked the {short} academy whether anyone could hand out a reading prize. {kid} arrived early, stayed two hours and signed everything put in front of him including the lectern and one teacher's laptop lid. The video has more views than the club's last three tries combined.
news.grAgentFlatteredSubj: AGENT TALK: {target} "flattered" by the interest, says everyone
news.grAgentFlattered: {target}'s representatives declined every opportunity to hose this down: "My client is very happy at {other}. But every player listens." Rugby's translation service has been working overtime. The fan forums did the rest before lunch.
news.grForumDreamSubj: FAN FORUM: the "realistic transfer targets" thread is anything but
news.grForumDream: The {short} thread is titled "realistic targets" and {target} appears on every page of it. The finances are impossible, the positional fit is questionable and the enthusiasm is absolute. Somebody has made a graphic. Somebody else has made a better one.
news.grRefMicSubj: REF MIC: the clip every group chat is quoting
news.grRefMic: A referee's exchange with a front row from the weekend has escaped containment: "You are not bound. You have never been bound." Refereeing socials are calling it a masterclass in communication. Props are calling it slander and have opened a group chat of their own.
news.grPropGymSubj: SOCIAL: {propLast} lifts something he should not have lifted
news.grPropGym: {prop} has posted a gym clip that the strength coach describes, on the record, as "not a programmed movement". It has a hundred thousand views and a duet from a professional strongman who appears genuinely concerned. The {short} physio has commented on it too. The comment is one full stop.
news.grPropMarathonSubj: CHARITY: {propLast} agrees to a half marathon, hears "half an hour"
news.grPropMarathon: A supporters' club raffle has committed {prop} to thirteen miles for charity. The acceptance was confident and on camera, followed by a question that revealed the word heard was "half an hour". The fundraising total has tripled since the clip went up.
news.grNineMicSubj: REF MIC: {nineLast} spends eighty minutes coaching the referee
news.grNineMic: The audio from the weekend has {nine} offering the official guidance on the offside line, the tackle height, the clock and, at one point, the official's own positioning. The referee's reply has been turned into a ringtone. Nobody involved regrets anything.
news.grKitLeakSubj: SOCIAL: {shortPoss} new shirt leaks a day early, on a bad mannequin
news.grKitLeak: Next season's kit appeared on a reseller feed before the launch, photographed on a mannequin with one arm and a haunted expression. The club is furious. The fans have moved past the club's feelings and are now conducting a full referendum on the collar. Verdict: divisive.
news.grGroundsmanSubj: GROUNDSMAN WATCH: visiting coach calls the {stadium} pitch "a ploughed field"
news.grGroundsman: The head groundsman has responded through visibly gritted teeth that "the surface rewards a team willing to keep the ball in hand". The visiting coach has kept a boot as evidence and photographed it next to a ruler. The groundsman has photographed the ruler.
news.grMascotSubj: MASCOT INCIDENT: the {short} mascot is trending for all the wrong reasons
news.grMascot: A half-time penalty shootout ended with the mascot taking out a nine-year-old at the knees and celebrating in front of the family stand. The club has issued an apology. The mascot has issued nothing, because the mascot is committed to the bit, and gained forty thousand followers overnight.
news.grAnnouncerSubj: STADIUM PA: announcer reads out the wrong team, then doubles down
news.grAnnouncer: The {stadium} announcer named the entire opposition XV as the home side, realised at fifteen, and elected to finish the list anyway "for consistency". The crowd applauded every name. Away supporters have started a petition to have him do their team sheet every week.
news.grPieSubj: CATERING: the {short} pie has been reviewed, and the review is 900 words
news.grPie: A widely followed food account has awarded the ground's steak pie a mark of 6.4 with the note "structurally ambitious, emotionally cold". The club has responded by putting the score on a chalkboard outside the kiosk. Sales are up thirty per cent. The pie has not changed.
news.grDroneSubj: TRAINING LEAK: a drone over {short} training gets exactly nothing
news.grDrone: Somebody flew a drone over a closed session hoping for the team sheet and captured forty minutes of a squad doing a passing drill in complete silence, plus one man tying a lace for nine of them. The footage has been posted anyway. It has done numbers.
news.grSeagullSubj: WILDLIFE: a seagull holds up play at {stadium} for two minutes
news.grSeagull: A single gull occupied the 22 and declined every invitation to leave, including one from a second row who tried reasoning. Play resumed when the bird took a pie from row three and departed on its own terms. It now has a fan account with more followers than two of the players.
news.grMerchTypoSubj: MERCH: {short} sell out of a shirt with a spelling mistake on it
news.grMerchTypo: A print run went out with the club motto missing a letter, which the club discovered from a supporter's post rather than from the supplier. The recall lasted ninety minutes before somebody noticed the mistaken ones were reselling for triple. The recall has been quietly cancelled.
news.grBannerSubj: TERRACES: {short} fans unveil a banner nobody can read
news.grBanner: Months of planning went into a full-length tifo for the weekend, and it went up upside down and back to front. From the far stand it appears to say something rude about {short} themselves. The group behind it has declared this "the intended reading all along" and is taking commissions.
news.grStreamSubj: BROADCAST: the {short} stream cuts to a fixed shot of a car park for six minutes
news.grStream: A gallery mix-up sent the live feed to an unmanned camera pointed at the players' entrance during the busiest passage of the match. Nineteen thousand people watched a car park and, by minute four, were commentating on it. The clip has outperformed the highlights.
news.grSponsorSubj: SPONSORS: {shortPoss} new partner is a funeral director and the fans love it
news.grSponsor: The commercial team expected a mild reaction to the sleeve deal and instead got the best day their social accounts have ever had. Supporters were asked for a slogan and thousands answered, most unprintable. The winner goes on the sleeve next week: "With you at the death."
news.grWeatherSubj: WEATHER: hail stops the {short} warm-up and starts a snowball fight
news.grWeather: Sixty seconds of freak hail emptied the pitch and produced footage of two professional squads abandoning their preparation to pelt each other in front of an empty stand. Both head coaches have described it as "not ideal". Both clubs' accounts have posted it.
news.grBusSubj: LOGISTICS: the {short} team bus takes a wrong turn into a wedding
news.grBus: A satnav sent the coach down a lane and into the car park of a hotel mid-reception. The squad were applauded in, photographed with the couple, and applauded out. The bride's cousin has since been photographed at {stadium} in a replica shirt.
news.grQuizSubj: SOCIAL: {short} players fail a quiz about their own club, publicly
news.grQuiz: The media team filmed a light-hearted club history quiz and released it without watching it back. Nobody named the ground's record attendance, one man guessed the club was founded in 1998, and the captain named a competition that has never existed. It is the club's most watched video of the season.
news.grCatSubj: WILDLIFE: a cat is now a member of the {short} coaching staff
news.grCat: A stray that adopted the training ground gates has been photographed sitting in on the forwards' meeting, on the whiteboard side of the room. The club has given it a name, a bowl and, this week, a squad number in the region of 47. The kit man is drafting a shirt.
news.grTmoSubj: TMO: eight minutes to decide something everybody in the ground had decided
news.grTmo: The weekend's showpiece stopped for eight minutes while officials examined a grounding from eleven angles, four of them worse than the naked eye. The eventual decision matched the first replay. Broadcasters have cut it into a montage with a ticking clock and it is doing very well.
news.grKickerNetSubj: SOCIAL: a supporter lands a halfway kick and the internet demands a contract
news.grKickerNet: A half-time competition entrant in jeans and work boots struck one from inside their own half and straight through, then did it again for the cameras. Two clubs have posted the clip. One head coach has been asked about it in a press conference and did not entirely rule it out.
news.grSheepSubj: VILLAGE RUGBY: match abandoned when forty sheep occupy the home 22
news.grFloodlights: The floodlights at {stadium} failed with twenty minutes to play, and the match finished in a gloom with no TMO and no cameras. The scoreboard was not kind to {short}. Supporters have called the power cut the kindest thing to happen to them all season.
news.grHarbourShield: {short} celebrated a cup win with a boat trip round the harbour, and the trophy went over the side before the first drink was poured. A club volunteer who dives at weekends brought it back up ten minutes later. The trophy has been polished. The volunteer has been given a season ticket and the captaincy of the boat.
news.grInflatablesSubj: {short} ban inflatables from the team bus
news.grInflatables: Ahead of the annual fancy dress trip, {short} have banned inflatables from the team bus. The club will not say what happened last year. The driver will, to anyone who asks, and at length.
news.grStormPizza: Storms held up kick-off at {stadium} for nearly three hours. {short} insist the squad stayed focused throughout. The delivery driver who carried eleven large pizzas down the tunnel tells a different story.
news.grLightning: Lightning over {stadium} ended a match in the 68th minute, and the score at the time stands as the result. {short} were a point ahead. Nobody at the club has ever been so grateful for weather.
news.grDeer: A deer ran the full length of the pitch at {stadium} and flattened {star} on the way through. Player and deer are both fine. The deer has not been cited, although the {short} defence coach has asked for its contact details.
news.grGripMachine: {star} broke the grip-strength machine in the fan zone at the first attempt. The sponsor has promised a sturdier model, and an invoice. The broken one is now on display in the {short} clubhouse, with a small brass plaque.
news.grTattooPact: {star} has promised to have the head coach's face tattooed on a calf if {short} win the league. The coach has asked that a flattering photo be used. The club photographer has been put on standby, just in case.
news.grAirportCafe: {star} was still in the airport café, finishing a toastie, when the {short} flight took off. The player arrived four hours later by a connection nobody can pronounce, and has been fined exactly the price of the toastie.
news.grFeedsSix: A steakhouse near {stadium} advertises a platter that "feeds six". {prop} finished it alone and then asked to see the dessert menu. The restaurant has named the platter after the player and quietly put the price up.
news.grBarbecue: At a {short} squad barbecue, {prop} was promoted to head chef inside five minutes and would not give the tongs back for the rest of the evening. Reviews are mixed. The sausages were described by one teammate as "structurally sound".
news.grHeatwave: A heatwave has baked the pitch at {stadium} so hard that {short} have called off contact training. The squad played touch rugby in the car park instead, and {prop} spent most of it stretching in the shade of the team bus.
news.grLovelyDecision: The referee's microphone caught {nine} saying "lovely decision, sir" seconds before the next penalty went the other way. The clip has been watched across the league, and the {short} squad have appointed {nineLast} their official diplomat, effective immediately.
news.grGoldenPoint: Ever since golden point was mentioned at a league meeting, {kid} has practised drop goals in the {short} car park every evening. Three car windows have been replaced so far. The club has bought a net.
news.grKitClash: The kit man packed the {short} home strip for the trip to {other}, who wear almost exactly the same colours. {short} played the first half in training bibs. The kit man has been given a laminated calendar and a long look.
news.grPlaylist: The {other} coach walked out of the post-match press conference after four minutes, because the music from the {short} dressing room next door was too loud to hear the questions. {short} have apologised and released the playlist. It has had more listens than the highlights.
news.grWanderingFanSubj: A new voice in the {short} end
news.grWanderingFan: A young {other} supporter wandered into the {short} end at half-time, was adopted by the choir and went home knowing every song. The family report that the singing has not stopped since. The choir has asked about availability for next season.
news.chTale9Subj: CLUBHOUSE: one answer fits all at quiz night
news.chTale9: {prop} has been banned from the team quiz for answering every question with "scrummaging". It was the right answer twice. The quizmaster says that is exactly the problem.
news.chTale10: Someone has been eating the kit man's sandwiches from the fridge. A notice has gone up, the physio has been appointed to investigate, and three props have produced alibis nobody asked for. The sandwiches are now labelled in capital letters.
news.chTale11: {wing} has been doing sprint drills on the beach at dawn. On the first morning a dog joined in. By the third there was a small crowd, a man selling coffee, and a local reporter timing the dog.
news.chTale12: The dressing-room playlist has become a matter of real tension. The forwards want power ballads, the backs want something with a drop in it, and the kit man has been caught adding brass bands. A committee has been formed. It has not met, because nobody can agree on the music.
news.grSheep: A gate left open at a sixth-tier fixture admitted an entire flock at a penalty advantage. The referee consulted both captains, consulted the sheep, and abandoned the game with the immortal full-time line: "Gentlemen, they have more numbers and better shape than either defence." The league has ordered a replay. The farmer has ordered a season ticket.
news.grTrophyLostSubj: SILVERWARE: a village club has been polishing the wrong trophy for 42 years
news.grTrophyLost: During an insurance valuation, the county junior cup a village side has displayed since 1984 turned out to be a regional best-kept-allotment award with a rugby ball soldered on. Nobody knows where the real cup went. The club has voted unanimously to keep the allotment one, on the grounds that "we definitely won something, and this is shinier."
news.grPostmanSubj: GRASSROOTS: fourth-tier club discovers their postman has been at every away game for 20 years
news.grPostman: A club historian assembling an anniversary album noticed the same figure at the edge of every away photograph since 2006. It is their postman, who has never mentioned it once on the round. Asked why, the answer was a refusal to make it about anybody. The club has retired the number 24 in tribute: one for every away shirt never asked for.
news.grDogTrySubj: VILLAGE RUGBY: a dog scores the decisive try and the league has to rule on it
news.grDogTry: A spaniel invaded a promotion decider, intercepted a flat pass and crossed the line to what witnesses describe as the loudest cheer in the ground's history. The referee disallowed it for offside, reasoning the dog "entered from in front of the kicker". The league has upheld the decision but named the spaniel in its team of the week, at openside.
news.grAnthemSubj: MATCHDAY: the wrong anthem plays and both teams commit to it completely
news.grAnthem: An admin error at a cup tie played the theme from a daytime antiques programme instead of the national anthem. Neither side broke formation. Thirty professional rugby players stood at full attention through ninety seconds of light harpsichord, hands on hearts, and the crowd joined in humming. The clip has more views than the match.
news.grScrumCafeSubj: COMMUNITY: a front row opens a coffee shop where everything is scrum-named and nothing is explained
news.grScrumCafe: Three retired props have opened a cafe with a menu that includes the Loosehead Latte, the Tighthead Flat White and a pastry called the Collapsed Maul, which arrives deliberately flattened. Tourists keep asking why the sugar sachets say "BIND" on them. The owners refuse to say. It is the best-reviewed coffee shop in the county.
news.grLineoutLadderSubj: GRASSROOTS: club banned from using their new lineout tactic involving an actual stepladder
news.grLineoutLadder: An eighth-tier side unveiled a routine in which the hooker threw to a jumper standing on a stepladder painted in club colours. It worked three times before the referee found the relevant law, which took eleven minutes, because nobody had ever needed it before. The league's written ruling begins "with reluctant admiration" and the ladder now hangs in the clubhouse.
news.grFogMatchSubj: WEATHER: two teams play twelve minutes in fog before discovering the ball went home
news.grFogMatch: A cup tie in dense fog continued in fine spirit until both packs converged on a ruck that turned out to be a training bag. Investigation revealed a clearing kick in the third minute had left the ground entirely, and a spectator, believing the game over, had taken the ball home for a child. The league has ordered a replay. The child is keeping the ball.
news.chTale1Subj: CLUBHOUSE: {propLast} wins the squad golf day, refuses to be humble
news.chTale1: {prop} shot the round of his life at the team golf day and has already had the scorecard laminated. It is now blu-tacked inside his locker at eye level. The backs have demanded a recount; the referee (the kit man) says the result stands.
news.chTale2Subj: CLUBHOUSE: ice bath declared too small for the front row
news.chTale2: The new recovery suite opened this week, and within a day the front row lodged a formal complaint that the ice bath "fits one and a half props maximum". A rota has been posted. {prop} has annexed the 6pm slot indefinitely and laminated that too.
news.chTale3Subj: CLUBHOUSE: {lockLast} adopts the groundsman's dog, sort of
news.chTale3: The groundsman's terrier has decided {lock} is its favourite person on earth and now attends every session, sitting neatly beside the tackle bags. The club shop is printing a tiny replica shirt. Nobody has told the groundsman where his dog spends its days, but he probably knows.
news.chTale4Subj: CLUBHOUSE: half-backs in bus playlist standoff
news.chTale4: {nine} and {ten} have shared control of the team bus playlist for two seasons, and the arrangement has finally collapsed over what the squad describe only as "the incident with the sea shanties". A peace deal now alternates song by song. The forwards, who wanted silence, have lost again.
news.chTale5Subj: CLUBHOUSE: {wingLast} loses race to a schoolboy, demands rematch
news.chTale5: At a community visit this week the fastest man at the club was beaten over 40 metres by a twelve-year-old wearing school shoes. {wing} maintains the start was jumped and has formally requested a rematch "on a proper track, with blocks". The twelve-year-old's PE teacher is considering terms.
news.chTale6Subj: CLUBHOUSE: team-room quiz night ends in googling scandal
news.chTale6: Wednesday's quiz night was abandoned at the sports round when one table of forwards answered a question about 1987 with suspicious speed and in full sentences. Phones are now surrendered at the door, and the quizmaster (the physio) has been given "full disciplinary powers". He has had a lanyard made. Nobody knows how to tell him it has gone too far.
news.chTale7Subj: CLUBHOUSE: the kit man's biannual sock audit strikes fear into all
news.chTale7: It is sock audit week. The kit man has counted out, counted back, and found the squad collectively nine pairs short. An amnesty box has appeared outside the changing room with a sign reading "NO QUESTIONS ASKED (THIS TIME)". Three pairs have already been returned under cover of darkness.
news.chTale8Subj: CLUBHOUSE: bus driver gets a guard of honour for his 200th away trip
news.chTale8: Two hundred away trips, zero breakdowns, one legendary flask. The squad formed a guard of honour in the car park this week for the team bus driver, who described it as "completely unnecessary" while visibly delighted. He has been presented with a shirt with WHEELS 1 on the back.
news.lawWatch1Subj: LAW WATCH: 25-point "super try" floated for length-of-the-field scores
news.lawWatch1: A working group has proposed quintuple points for tries begun behind a team's own 22. Coaches call it "bingo rugby". Fans have already built entire imaginary seasons around it. The world governing body stresses it is "one idea among many", which is committee language for never.
news.lawWatch2Subj: LAW WATCH: proposal to reduce teams to 13 players "under review"
news.lawWatch2: A discussion paper suggests trimming the XV to thirteen to "open space and cut collisions". The northern unions are apoplectic, the southern unions intrigued, and one existing sport with exactly that player count is watching with its arms folded. Expect a quiet burial by autumn.
news.lawWatch3Subj: LAW WATCH: shot clock for scrums - 30 seconds or a free-kick
news.lawWatch3: The proposal: packs get half a minute from mark to engagement or concede the put-in. Front rows everywhere describe the idea as "a war crime". Referees privately love it. The trial is earmarked for a development competition nobody can name, which tells you everything.
news.lawWatch4Subj: LAW WATCH: kicks at goal worth less in the final quarter, says think-tank
news.lawWatch4: Penalties would drop to two points after the hour "to encourage ambition". Kickers are furious, flankers delighted, and the fan forums have run the numbers on every classic final and declared history itself invalid. The world governing body thanks the think-tank for its input.
news.lawWatch5Subj: LAW WATCH: unlimited substitutions trial mooted for pre-season
news.lawWatch5: Rolling subs, all match, every match. Conditioning coaches are drooling; purists are drafting strongly worded letters with footnotes. The proposal is "at concept stage", a phrase that has preceded precisely nothing becoming law in the sport's history.
news.lawWatch6Subj: LAW WATCH: golden point extra time for all league matches "on the table"
news.lawWatch6: No more draws, ever, says the paper - first score after 80 wins it. The romantics mourn the honourable draw; the broadcasters have already cut a trailer. The league's fixture staff, asked to model the overtime, sent back a single spreadsheet cell reading "no".
news.wWin1: Three wins on the spin and the {stadium} bars are humming. A supporters' podcast this week: "Whisper it, but this {manager} side might actually be building something."
news.wWin2: Three straight wins and the queue at the club shop has opinions about silverware. The older heads keep saying "long season" and grinning while they say it.
news.wWin3: The terraces have a new song and it has {manager} in it. Three wins running will do that. Keep winning and they will add verses.
news.wWin4: Three on the bounce, and the man who runs the burger van says takings are up - "winning makes them hungry." The most honest economic indicator in rugby.
news.wWin5: A lad in the family stand has started bringing a homemade cardboard trophy. Three straight wins. His dad keeps apologising to the row behind and nobody minds.
news.wWinOn1: The winning run rolls on and the ground has stopped whispering about it. Away fans arrive expecting the worst now, which is the highest compliment a terrace can pay.
news.wWinOn2: Still winning. The older heads have given up saying "long season" and started asking about final tickets, quietly, in case saying it out loud breaks something.
news.wWinOn3: The run goes on, and the club shop has sold out of scarves in October. Somebody in the sponsors' lounge used the word "era". Nobody laughed.
news.wLose1: Three straight defeats and the phone-ins have turned. One season-ticket holder of 30 years: "I don't see a plan out there." Win this weekend and it all goes quiet - that's football... no, that's rugby.
news.wLose2: Three losses in a row and the fan forum's match thread got locked by midnight. The mood is not mutinous yet, but the mods are stretched thin.
news.wLose3: The drive home after a third straight defeat is where seasons are judged, and this week's radio callers judged hard. One result changes the weather. You need it.
news.wLose4: Third defeat running and the club shop has quietly moved the replica shirts away from the window. Nobody ordered that. Everybody understood it.
news.wLose5: After a third straight loss the fanzine ran a blank page with the caption "analysis". Cruel, brief, and pinned up in three pubs by Sunday lunchtime.
news.wLoseOn1: The losing run has outlasted the anger. The phone-ins have gone quiet, which every manager knows is worse: nobody argues about a side they have given up on.
news.wLoseOn2: Still no win. The terraces have moved from fury to gallows humour, and the away end knows all the punchlines. One result would change everything, and everyone knows which result.
news.wLoseOn3: The slump goes on and the man with the flask in row F has started bringing a book. He has renewed every year since 1987. He will renew again. He would just like a reason.
news.wKid1: Every scout in the league has {clubPoss} {age}-year-old {pos} {player} in their notebook. Coaches say the polish has come on this season. One director of rugby: "That will cost a fortune in a year. Move now or regret it."
news.wKid2: {player}, {age}, is the name scouts keep writing down twice. {club} know exactly what they have; the question is how long they can keep it quiet.
news.wKid3: The stopwatch brigade were out in force again for {clubPoss} {pos} {player}. He is {age}. The men in the stand with clipboards were not there for the tea.
news.wMerc1: - and his agent is already dialling

news.wMerc3: - and this one pays an agent to be loud
news.wGrumble1: Sources say {player} ({pos}, rated among your best) trained away from the main group on Monday. His camp's message: "He didn't come here to hold tackle bags." Play him, sell him, or watch the mood sour{merc1_k}.
news.wGrumble2: {player} has started every week the same way: brilliant in training, absent from the team sheet. People around the squad have begun saying "situation" out loud{merc2_k}. Minutes or a move: it is heading one way.
news.wGrumble3: The cameras caught {player} watching the warm-up from the bench again, jaw set. A {pos} of his standing does not stay quiet forever{merc3_k}. The dressing room is watching how you handle it.
news.wDeadlineAhead: The mid-season market reaches its climax over the next two rounds. Chairmen panic, agents feast, medicals happen in car parks at midnight. If you're planning a move - for a signing or a sale - now is the moment. Expect the phone to ring.
news.wWindowShut: Deadline chaos over. Sporting directors emerge blinking into the daylight to explain themselves. Business can still be done, but the frenzy is over for another year.
news.runDies: {n} competitive games unbeaten, and it ends here. The dressing room is silent; the phone-ins are not. Runs like that are not replaced; they are rebuilt, one week at a time - and every side in the league sleeps a little easier tonight.
news.run8Subj: Eight unbeaten: the league has noticed
news.run8: {club} have not lost a competitive game in two months, and the fixture list changes character from here: nobody circles a mid-table trip, everybody circles the unbeaten side. Expect every opponent to play their cup final against you. The old heads in your squad will carry the weight; watch the young ones.
news.run12Subj: Twelve unbeaten: the target on the shirt is real
news.run12: A dozen without defeat. Opposition coaches now plan their whole week around you, and the neutrals have started turning up to watch the run end. Pressure is a tax the well-led pay at a discount: keep the room right and the run breathes; let it wobble and the weight does the opposition's work for them.
news.run16: Nobody at the club is allowed to say it, so everybody outside it is saying it for them: invincible. Sixteen competitive matches without defeat is the kind of season grandchildren get told about. Every week from here is a final, for both teams on the pitch.

bossNotLookingDown.one: {boss} has been enjoying himself. "Somebody asked whether I keep an eye on {me}. I keep an eye on the table, and the table says what it says." That is a {n}-point gap he is inviting you to look at. Pin it up somewhere useful.
bossNotLookingDown.other: {boss} has been enjoying himself. "Somebody asked whether I keep an eye on {me}. I keep an eye on the table, and the table says what it says." That is a {n}-point gap he is inviting you to look at. Pin it up somewhere useful.

news.bossPressure: A rough morning for {short}, where {boss} was asked twice about still having the dressing room. "Judge me in May." The next question was about the {n}-point gap to {meShort}, and it went unanswered. Boards read those transcripts too.
news.bossSize1: {boss} was polite about {me} and meant almost none of it. "A well-coached side. Organised. They know exactly what they are, which is a compliment, whatever anybody hears in it." Nothing between you in the table, and not much between you in the press room either.
news.bossSize2: Asked to name the side he least wants to draw, {boss} went somewhere else entirely. "I would not give anybody that headline." Pressed on {meShort} specifically, he said they were "hard to play against on their day", which is a sentence with a trapdoor in it.
news.bossSize3: {boss} says he has stopped watching the table. "It is August somewhere in my head. I will look in April." He then named {mePoss} last three results from memory, in order, which rather gave the game away.
news.bossSize4: A short one from {boss} this morning. "{meShort}? Good club, good crowd, good coach." Three compliments and not one word about their rugby. He knows exactly what he is doing.
news.bossTight: {club}'s {boss} was asked about you this morning and did not bother pretending. "{who_k}, with everything still to play for. I have watched every game they have played this year. They are good. We are better in the tight five, and I think that is what decides it." {gap_k}, and he has just made it personal.
news.bossTightSubjB: {boss} on the run-in: "We are better in the tight five"
news.reinvest: The books closed well and the board will not let the money sit. {spend} goes back into {club} this summer: the ground debt cleared, the academy funded again, the community programme kept in the schools that feed this place. Reserve: {reserve}.
news.reinvestBuild: The books closed well and the board will not let the money sit. {spend} goes back into {club} this summer: {name_k} to level {lvl}, the ground debt cleared, the academy funded again. Reserve: {reserve}. Spend the transfer budget on players, not interest.

You finished {pos_o}. Somebody else gets to have an opinion about that next year.

news.clubLegendSubj: CLUB LEGEND: the city claims you as its own

There is talk of a statue outside {stadium}, and the artist has already asked how you would like to be posed. Results can dip; this cannot be taken away.

The season ends the way it should - the whole squad in one room, telling lies about each other.

{rows_ll}

news.loanBack: A season of regular rugby has done {player} the world of good. He reports back noticeably sharper.
news.loanEnds: The loan is over. {player} heads back to his parent club having grown from the rugby you gave him.
news.seasonBegins: Pre-season is over. Your transfer budget has been set at {budget}. Bring us silverware.
news.upAndDownSubj: Up and down: the trapdoors swing across the leagues
news.upAndDown: {rows_l}. Fortunes made and unmade in a single afternoon, and next season's fixture lists are redrawn accordingly.
news.barKept: {kept} win the relegation playoff {hi}-{lo} and keep their Premier Division place; {stay} stay down
news.barSurvived: {line_k}. The great escape, done on your own patch. The board exhales - now never come this close again.
news.barSoClose: {line_k}. Champions of the second tier, beaten in one game for everything. The board keeps faith: win the league again and finish the job.
news.relegated: {how_k} The board is wounded and the budget will feel it - win the league and bounce straight back.
news.promoted: {how_k} The big time. The board urges cool heads: survival is the first objective.

news.lastDanceSubj: The last dance: {player} announces his farewell season

news.warChestKept: You told the world to judge you in May, and May agreed. The {fund} the board put behind the promise stays spent with their blessing, and the chairman is already quoting you in the season-ticket letter.

Still under contract. That has never been the same thing as being unavailable.

He is properly scouted now: a true reading, not a range.

news.postcardKeen: Watched {player} twice now and I would put my name to him. {age}, {pos_k} {at_k}, and he does the things you cannot teach.
news.postcardMaybe: {player} is worth a mention. {age}, {pos_k} {at_k}. Not the answer on his own, but I would not rule him out.
news.scoutReport: {months} months, {n} {names_k}, {good} of them he would sign tomorrow. Top of the list: {player}, {age}, {pos_k} {at_k} - {note_k} The full report is in the Transfer Centre, and every man on it is now properly known to your recruitment staff.
news.noteA1: Ready now and he would walk into your XV.
news.noteA2: The best in his position I have watched all trip.
news.noteA3: Do not let this one get away.
news.noteB1: Would strengthen the squad and grow into more.
news.noteB2: A season of proper coaching and he is a starter.
news.noteC1: Squad depth, nothing more, but honest with it.
news.noteC2: Useful in a crisis. Not one to build around.
news.noteC3: Worth a look if the price is right.
news.noteD1: One good afternoon does not make a career.
news.noteD2: I have seen better, but somebody will pay for him.

news.wcDrawWSubj: World Championship draw: the rankings pick the pools

The World Championship pools are set, seeded from the world rankings. Top seeds: {top_l}.

The World Championship pools are set, seeded from the world rankings. Top seeds: {top_l}.
{nationCap_k} go in as the {seed_o} seed - anything short of {bar_k}.
news.wcBarSemi: the semi-finals will be a failure
news.wcBarKnockout: the knockouts would still be par
news.sponsorSigned: {sponsor} take the {slot_k} for {yrs_k} at {weekly} a week. The commercial department is pleased with itself, and the money starts arriving on Friday.{naming_k}
news.sponsorSignedClause: {sponsor} take the {slot_k} for {yrs_k} at {weekly} a week, with a clause: {clause_k} Deliver and it is the best deal in the building. Do not, and you have sold cheap.{naming_k}
news.sponsorSignedPerf: {sponsor} take the {slot_k} for {yrs_k} at {weekly} a week guaranteed, with bonuses worth up to {top} a season on results. The league target is position {target} or better. Deliver and it is the best deal in the building; do not, and the club has sold cheap.{naming_k}
news.sponsorNaming: The signage vans arrive Monday: the ground plays as {stadium} for the length of the deal.
news.sponsorExpires: The {slot_k} is out of contract: {sponsor} have reached the end of their term. The commercial department has taken a rolling deal with {newSponsor} at {rate} a week - under the going rate, because nobody argued for you. Better offers are there whenever you want them.
news.sponsorBonus: The season's performance bonuses are in: {met} of {n} targets met across the club's sponsorship deals, worth {amount}. Paid by {sponsors}.
news.sponsorBonusNone: Not one of the {n} performance targets in the club's sponsorship deals was met this season, so the bonuses pay nothing. The guaranteed fees still stand.
news.aCoachNamed: {coach} has filed the A League report.
news.aCoachNamedV2: The A League notes are in from {coach}.
news.aCoachNamedV3: {coach} reports from the A League weekend.
news.aCoachAnon: The academy coach has filed the A League report.
news.aCoachAnonV2: The A League notes are in from the academy.
news.aCoachAnonV3: The academy staff report from the A League weekend.
news.aWonLine0: Results at this level are not the point, but a winning habit at nineteen is worth having.
news.aWonLine1: He was more pleased with the last twenty minutes than the scoreline, which tells you plenty.
news.aWonLine2: A win, and more importantly nobody came off holding anything.
news.aWonLine3: The coach says the front row grew up a fortnight in eighty minutes.
news.aWonLine4: Two of them will train with the seniors this week off the back of that.
news.aWonLine5: He signed off with one line: "That is the standard now."
news.aLostLine0: The scoreline matters less than the minutes. Every one of them went into a young man who needed them.
news.aLostLine1: A beating, and the coach is not remotely bothered. They learned more today than in a month of drills.
news.aLostLine2: He wants you to know which three kept going at 20 down, because those are the three who will make it.
news.aLostLine3: Chastening, and useful. The video session will be quiet and long.
news.aLostLine4: Nobody hid. That was his whole report, and it is the one thing he cares about.
news.aLostLine5: The coach reckons they were beaten by bigger men, and that bigger men are a matter of time.
news.memoNoRugby: Form: no competitive rugby in this window - an international break, and nothing to judge you on.
news.memoTable: League: {pos_o} in the {comp} on the season so far.
news.memoMoney: Finances: {word_k} at {bal}, transfer budget {budget}. Wage bill {bill}/wk.
news.memoMoneyCap: Finances: {word_k} at {bal}, transfer budget {budget}. Wage bill {bill}/wk against a {cap} cap, {room} of room.
news.memoMoneyOver: Finances: {word_k} at {bal}, transfer budget {budget}. Wage bill {bill}/wk against a {cap} cap - WE ARE OVER IT.
news.memoVA0: Verdict: the boardroom is delighted. Keep going and this becomes your club.
news.memoVA1: Verdict: nobody here wants to talk about anything except how well this is going.
news.memoVA2: Verdict: you have the board's full backing, and you have earned it.
news.memoVB0: Verdict: the board is satisfied. Nothing here that a good month would not improve.
news.memoVB1: Verdict: broadly happy. We would like to see this kicked on rather than held.
news.memoVB2: Verdict: solid. The directors are comfortable and would like to stay that way.
news.memoVC0: Verdict: patience is intact but it is not infinite. We expect the graph to turn.
news.memoVC1: Verdict: the mood upstairs is wait and see. Give us something to point at.
news.memoVC2: Verdict: neither pleased nor panicking. The next month matters more than this one.
news.memoVD0: Verdict: concern, stated plainly. This has to improve and soon.
news.memoVD1: Verdict: the board is worried, and some of it is being said out loud.
news.memoVD2: Verdict: we are not where anybody expected to be. We need a response.
news.memoVE0: Verdict: this is a formal warning. The board is discussing your position.
news.memoVE1: Verdict: the directors have lost patience. Results now, or a decision gets made for you.
news.memoVE2: Verdict: your position is under review. There is no gentler way to put it.
news.notOut: You turned {age} this summer, which in this trade is when people start asking the question in press conferences. There is no hurry: take another season, and another, and nobody will think less of you. The door is open from here and closes on its own at {forced}.
news.aTitleMine: The A side finish top of the {comp}: {w} wins from {p}, {pf} points scored. Nobody hangs a flag for it, and every coach in the building knows what it means - the pipeline is working, and the men who won it are the ones you will be picking in three years.
news.aTitleOther: {name} win the {comp} with {pts} points from {p} games.{pos_k} Development tables are not league tables, but the clubs at the top of them tend to be the clubs producing players.
news.takeoverTight: {club}'s new owners have arrived with accountants, not ambition. Expect their best players to be quietly available - at the right price.
news.takeoverTightMine: The deal is done - and the new owners' first act is an audit, their second a memo. Your transfer budget is cut to {budget} and every contract will be "reviewed for value". Sell before you buy, and expect the new chairman to watch every result.
news.takeoverRich: It's done. The consortium has completed its purchase of {club} and immediately pledged fresh investment. The rest of the league takes note: {short} just became dangerous in the market.
news.takeoverRichMine: It's done. Your new owner walks the training ground on day one and leaves a message with your secretary: the transfer budget is up {boost}, the wage ceiling is raised - and mediocrity is no longer on the menu. The next two months are your audition.
news.predTitle: {club} are everyone's title pick - anything less is failure.
news.predPlayoffs: {club} are tipped for the playoffs. The pressure is on from day one.
news.predMid: {club} are pegged mid-table - "solid, unspectacular" is the consensus. Prove them wrong.
news.predLast: The pundits have {club} dead last. Wooden spoon talk already. Use it.
news.predRelegation: {club} are among the relegation favourites. Nobody expects much - the perfect place to start.
news.predBottom: {club} are picked for the bottom half. Nobody expects much - the perfect place to start.
news.testimonialDay: {stadium} was full for {player}'s testimonial{scored_k}. The gate receipts ({gate}) go to the club at his insistence. One season left in the shirt: make it a good one.
news.testimonialScored: - and he scored, because of course he did
news.oldBoyWeWonSubj: Old boy {player} crosses against his former club
news.oldBoyWeWon: {player}, once of this parish, went over for {opp} - no celebration, just a nod to the away end. Your side had the last word on the scoreboard, which is all that matters.
news.oldBoyWeLostSubj: Old boy {player} crosses against his former club
news.oldBoyWeLost: Of course it was him. {player} - {apps} appearances in your colours before he left - crossed against his old club and the ground knew it was coming.
news.firstCap: {player} won a first Test cap for {nationThe_k} this week. The shirt gets framed; the club that made the player gets the reflected glow.
news.capMilestone: {player} brought up his {n_o} cap for {nationThe_k} this week - a special jersey, a guard of honour, and a proud week around the club.

suspended.one: The disciplinary panel has banned {player} for {n} match following his red card. He will be unavailable until the ban is served.
suspended.other: The disciplinary panel has banned {player} for {n} matches following his red card. He will be unavailable until the ban is served.

news.tottingUp: {n} yellow cards this season have earned {player} a one-match suspension under the league's totting-up rule.
news.debutAcademySubj: A debut to tell his grandkids about: {player}
news.debutAcademy: {player} ({age}, {pos}) made his first-team debut today - the academy's own, first competitive rugby of his life.{scored_k}{motm_k} Rated {rating} by the press box. The supporters have a new song by Tuesday.
news.debutSigning: First competitive appearance in the shirt for {player} ({pos}), and he made it count.{scored_k}{motm_k} Rated {rating} by the press box. The supporters have a new song by Tuesday.
news.debutScored: He scored, because new signings who cost the coaching staff sleep always do.
news.debutMotm: The sponsors gave him the match award before he had learned everyone's names.
news.mentorSpread: {name} has two kids under his wing and he mentioned it after training - politely, but he mentioned it. The extras are shared now, so each lad is learning at about three-quarter speed. Move one of them to another senior pro, or accept the slower pace.
news.scoutWhyThin: one injury from a crisis there
news.scoutWhyOld: {who} is {yrs} and the clock is honest
news.scoutWhyWeakest: the weakest shirt in the side
news.trBestA: Best on the grass: {name} - sharp all week.
news.trBestB: {name} trained like the ball was on a string. Best of the week by a distance.
news.trBestC: The staff vote for the week's best on the paddock was unanimous: {name}.
news.trBestD: {name} finished every drill first and every session smiling. Ominous for the opposition.
news.trPushA: Knocking on the door: {name} is training like a man who wants the shirt.
news.trPushB: {name} spent the week making the selection meeting awkward. Good.
news.trPushC: If team sheets were picked on a Tuesday, {name} starts this weekend.
news.trKidA: From the academy pitches: the coaches keep mentioning {name}. One for the notebook.
news.trKidB: {name} trained up with the seniors on Thursday and did not look out of place.
news.trKidC: The academy staff have started staying late to watch {name}. That usually means something.
news.trFocus: Focus this week: {prep_k} work, as ordered.
news.trNoPrep: No match preparation set - the week ran on autopilot.
news.mrRout1: A statement. {us} were ruthless from the first whistle.
news.mrRout2: {opp} will not want to watch that back. Total control, first minute to last.
news.mrRout3: One of those afternoons when everything you drew on the whiteboard actually happened.
news.mrComfort1: A convincing afternoon's work, controlled from the front.
news.mrComfort2: Professional. Ahead early, managed from there, nobody hurt. Take it and move on.
news.mrComfort3: The scoreboard says comfortable. The forwards' knuckles say earned.
news.mrNarrow1: Tight, tense - and yours. Games like this one win seasons.
news.mrNarrow2: Ugly wins count double in the dressing room. Nobody sings about the performance; everybody sings.
news.mrNarrow3: Decided by inches and nerve. Yours held.
news.mrDraw1: Honours even, and nobody quite sure how to feel about it.
news.mrDraw2: A draw that will feel like two points dropped or one rescued, depending on the day you had.
news.mrDraw3: All square. The handshakes were polite and nobody meant them.
news.mrNearMiss1: The finest of margins, the wrong side of them. It will sting for a few days.
news.mrNearMiss2: Close enough to touch, and that is what makes it worse. One moment, either way.
news.mrNearMiss3: Beaten, barely. The review will find three plays that would have flipped it.
news.mrBeaten1: A day to forget. The video session on Monday will be a long one.
news.mrBeaten2: {opp} were better in every department, and the score was honest about it.
news.mrBeaten3: Second to everything, including the excuses. Training just got harder.
news.appealUpheld: The panel reviewed the footage frame by frame and knocked a match off the suspension. {rest_k}
news.appealFreeToPlay: He is free to play this weekend.

appealDismissed.one: The panel called the challenge "without merit" and added a match for its trouble. The chairman's jaw tightens upstairs. {n} match to serve.
appealDismissed.other: The panel called the challenge "without merit" and added a match for its trouble. The chairman's jaw tightens upstairs. {n} matches to serve.

news.campHeatSubj: Camp report: sharp, brown and slightly broken
news.campHeat: A week of double sessions in serious heat. The GPS numbers are the best the staff have ever logged in pre-season, and the group tightened the way only shared suffering manages. {cost} well spent, probably.
news.campHomeSubj: Community week: the town turns out
news.campHome: Open training drew a four-figure crowd on a Tuesday. Every school in the area got a visit, every junior club got a coach. It cost almost nothing and bought the kind of goodwill money cannot.
news.campTour: Two exhibition matches, three time zones, one very happy sponsor and {fee} in the bank. The supporters grumble about a pre-season spent in departure lounges, and the squad starts the year with heavy legs.
news.toneSwaggerSubj: Swagger alert: is all that praise going to their heads?
news.toneSwagger: Your players can't stop telling the press how good they are - because you keep telling the press how good they are. The assistant's note is blunt: "Training tempo has dipped. They think they only need to turn up." Expect flat performances until someone puts a shift in, or until you sharpen your tongue.
news.toneBruisedSubj: Dressing room bruised by public criticism
news.toneBruised: Week after week of hard words in press conferences has landed. Senior players are reportedly "sick of being thrown under the bus" and morale has sagged across the squad. A little public warmth would go a long way.
news.grudgePreContract: they signed {player} on a pre-contract under our noses
news.grudgeBoiledOver: the last meeting boiled over - {cards} cards and a tunnel full of pushing
news.grudgeBrokeHeartsFinal: they broke our hearts in the {comp_k} final
news.grudgeBrokeHeartsSemi: they broke our hearts in the {comp_k} semi-final
news.riftContact: a flashpoint in Tuesday's contact session
news.riftDefRead: a row over a missed defensive read
news.riftBustUp: a training-ground bust-up witnessed by the whole squad
news.riftGym: a disagreement that started at the gym and followed them onto the pitch
news.transferDoneFree: {to} have completed the signing of {player}, who was without a club. The {age}-year-old has agreed terms of {wage}/week until {until}.
news.wcDrawW:
The World Championship pools are set, seeded from the world rankings. Top seeds: {top_l}.
Four pools, four nations each, and somewhere in there a group of death.
news.forfeit: {loser} could not field ten fit players and the match is awarded to {winner}, 28-0 with the try bonus. A squad that thin is a matter for the board.
news.forfeitSubj: Walkover: {loser} could not raise a side
news.playedOut: The match was left running at {min}'. Your assistant saw it out from there, making the changes and kicking for the posts when the chance came. Full time: {home} {hs}-{as} {away}.
news.boardInjection: The board have voted the funds through: {amount} lands in the transfer budget with immediate effect, and the wages to use it are underwritten from upstairs until the summer. The minutes record one condition - spend it like it matters.
news.charterSubj: New ownership: the wage law no longer applies
news.charter: The paperwork is signed and the lawyers have gone home. {club} are no longer bound by the league's salary cap - no ceiling, no fines, no embargoes, from this day forward. The league's statement is one cold paragraph. The agents' phones are already warm.
news.physioFavourSubj: The sponsor's consultant: {player} ahead of schedule

physioFavour.one: The club's shirt sponsor covered a consultant's review of {player}'s {injury_k}. A better rehab route was found: back a week earlier than feared.
physioFavour.other: The club's shirt sponsor covered a consultant's review of {player}'s {injury_k}. A better rehab route was found: back {n} weeks earlier than feared.

news.townCollection: The supporters' trust organised a collection for {club}: {amount}, in coins and notes and one farmer's cheque, handed over before training. The town does not intend to lose this club.
news.healSubj: The retreat: a clean bill of health
news.heal: The specialist retreat has done its work: {n} of the squad walked out with a clean bill of health. Every injury cleared, every man fresh. Match sharpness is the one thing medicine cannot buy, that comes back on Saturdays.
news.estate: The contractors have gone and the scaffolding with them: every facility at {club} now stands at its ceiling. Nine world-class buildings - and world-class running costs, which the books will feel every week.
news.pinnacle: Your name has gone to the federations, with a full dossier of your work attached. These things move quickly once they move at all: expect an approach within a fortnight.
news.dressingDownSubj: Dressing room whispers: {player} unhappy after dressing-down
news.dressingDown: Word has leaked that {player} was hauled in front of the coach over his recent form - and didn't take it well. Team-mates say he trained on his own on Tuesday.
news.boardPushedSubj: FORMAL WARNING: the board's answer stands
news.boardPushed: You were given a decision and you came back at the door regardless. The board takes that as a challenge to its authority, and says so in writing: the answer has not changed, confidence in your judgement is severely dented, and the next repetition of this conversation will be your last at the club.
news.sackedPushed: Warned in writing, and back at the boardroom door within the month anyway. The board decided the club needed a manager who could hear a no. {era} Your reputation travels with you. And so does the story of how this ended.
news.dreamRefocus: You set out to {dream_k}, and it is done. A manager needs a reason: when you are ready, name a new dream. The one you realised stays on the record for good.
news.sponsorEnded: {short} and {sponsor} have parted ways before the end of the {slot_k} deal, at the club's request. The money stops immediately - and three new parties have already been in touch about the vacant slot. Their terms are their own: some markets reward a club back on the market, some make it pay for the interruption.
news.natAppointed: It is official: you are the head coach of {nat_k}. Test windows, championship campaigns, and every trophy you win - it all goes in your cabinet; your assistant takes the club whenever your country plays. One thing left: whether you carry on at the club.
news.natAppointedOnly: It is official. You are the head coach of {nat_k}. Test windows, championship campaigns, and every trophy they win - it all goes in YOUR cabinet - and with no club on the desk, the country has your whole week.
news.fanSoldStar: {player} has gone to {to} and {club}'s support are not taking it well: the forums say this is a club selling its best and buying nobody, and one supporter has changed his profile picture to a black square. Fan mood down {n}.
news.fanSoldIcon: There is a difference between selling a player and selling one of their own, and {club}'s support know which this is. {player} has joined {to}. There is a bedsheet on the fence, and the phone-in ran ninety minutes with nobody defending it. Fan mood down {n}.
news.fanSignedStarSubj: {player} signs - and the town has noticed
news.fanSignedStar: {player} is a {club} player. The announcement video has been watched more times than the town has residents, the club shop has sold out of the letters in his name, and a local bakery is doing a limited-edition pastry nobody can describe. Fan mood is up {n}. {rival_k}
news.fanSignedIconSubj: THEY'VE ONLY GONE AND SIGNED HIM: {player}
news.fanSignedIcon: There were people on the streets. Actual people, on a Tuesday. {player} has signed for {club} and the town has lost all proportion: two babies named after the manager, a man tattooed somewhere he will regret, the club song eleven times before lunch. Fan mood up {n}. {rival_k}
news.fanRivalNamed: In the dressing room the mood is more complicated: {rival} has just watched his shirt get a great deal harder to keep.
news.fanRivalNone: Nobody in the squad plays where he plays, which is exactly why he was signed.
news.fanRumble: It is not a campaign yet. It is a tone. {boss} is being discussed rather than backed, the forums have a thread that is now nine pages long, and the word "direction" is being used a lot. Results settle this quickly, one way or the other.
news.fanRumbleV2: Nothing organised, just a mood. The supporters' podcast spent twenty minutes on {boss} this week and none of it on tactics. A couple of wins would change the subject.
news.fanRumbleV3: The letters page has noticed {club}, and not kindly. Questions about {boss} are being asked politely for now, which is the stage before they are asked loudly. Results are the only reply anyone listens to.
news.fanBanners: A section of the {club} support has organised: banners in the away end's eyeline, a hashtag, a petition with more names than the ground holds. The board have been asked about it twice this week and answered carefully both times. It costs {boss} confidence every week it runs.
news.fanPlane: They hired a plane. It flew over {stadium} for eleven minutes trailing a message about {boss}, and that photograph is now the picture every outlet uses for this club. The directors are no longer asked whether they back the manager. They are asked when.
news.fanForgiven: The banners are gone, the thread has died, and the singing on Saturday started before kick-off rather than after the first score. {club}'s support have decided they are behind {boss} after all. It buys time - not for ever, but the kind of time a manager can actually use.
news.fanForgivenV2: Whatever was being said about {boss} on the phone-ins has stopped. {club}'s support turned up early, stayed late and sang throughout. That buys some credit, if not a blank cheque.
news.fanForgivenV3Subj: Peace breaks out on the terraces
news.fanForgivenV3: The thread about {boss} has gone quiet and the season-ticket queue has not. {club}'s support are back behind the team, and the board have noticed the difference in the stands.
news.upStormSubj: The gale took the South Stand tarpaulin
news.upStorm: Three days of wind and {stadium} has lost most of the covering on the South Stand, two advertising boards and, for reasons the groundsman cannot explain, a wheelie bin that was later found in the car park of a garden centre. The repair comes to {amount}. The bin has been returned.
news.upRoof: The five-year survey on {stadium} came back with the word "urgent" in it more times than anybody would like. Steelwork, guttering and a section of cladding that has apparently been held on by paint since the nineties. {amount}, and the surveyor would like it known that he did warn them.
news.upPipeSubj: A burst pipe under the away changing room
news.upPipe: It went at four in the morning, which is the only good news in the story, and the away changing room at {stadium} spent six hours as a paddling pool. New flooring, new benches, and a plumber who kept saying "well there's your problem" without ever specifying what it was. {amount}.
news.upFloodlightsSubj: Two floodlight columns fail the inspection
news.upFloodlights: The lighting engineer walked round {stadium} with a clipboard and a look, and two columns did not pass. Replacement heads, a crane for a day, and a Tuesday night fixture that came within an hour of being played in what he cheerfully called "heritage lighting". {amount}.
news.upPitchSubj: The pitch has to be relaid
news.upPitch: The drainage has given up, the far corner has been more mud than grass since November, and the groundsman has started referring to it as "the bog" in official documents. A full hybrid relay at {stadium}: {amount}. The verdict from the grounds staff is that it will be worth it. They are right, and they will not stop saying it.
news.upForkliftSubj: A forklift, a hospitality suite, and a very quiet meeting
news.upForklift: Nobody has been named. Everybody knows. A forklift reversed through the partition wall of the hospitality suite at {stadium} on a Thursday afternoon, and the club is now short one partition wall, one drinks fridge and a print of the 1998 squad that the chairman was fond of. {amount}, and a new policy about who may drive what.
news.upBadger: A protected species has taken a serious interest in the drainage at {stadium}, and the law is extremely clear about who has to move. Ecologist, licence, exclusion fencing and a specialist relocation: {amount}. The groundsman has stopped speaking to anyone about it.
news.upDinnerSubj: The sportsman's dinner went off like a rocket
news.upDinner: Sold out in nine hours, a comedian who was funnier than he was expensive, and an auction that got completely out of hand when two local builders started bidding against each other for a signed shirt neither of them wanted. {club} are {amount} better off and the builders are no longer speaking.
news.upBeerFestSubj: The beer festival was rained on for three days
news.upBeerFest: Two hundred barrels, a marquee, a folk duo, and the wettest weekend since records began at {stadium}. The marquee held. The car park did not. What was budgeted as the summer's big earner is a loss of {amount}, and there is a great deal of beer in the cellar that somebody will have to drink.
news.upWeddingSubj: The function room is booked out until June
news.upWedding: Somebody in the commercial department had the idea of marketing {stadium} for weddings, and it has worked far better than anyone expected. Every Saturday is spoken for, the club has bought a second dance floor, and the groundsman has been asked twice whether the pitch can be walked on in heels. {amount} to the good.
news.upConcertSubj: A stadium concert, and the grass will forgive us
news.upConcert: Forty thousand people, one very famous act, and a stage build that took eleven days. {stadium} banks {amount}, the groundsman has aged visibly, and the far touchline will be a slightly different colour until March. The board have already asked when the next one is.
news.upFunRunSubj: The fun run raised more than expected
news.upFunRun: Fourteen hundred people ran round {stadium} in fancy dress on a Sunday morning. A man in a full front-row scrum costume, alone, finished in under an hour and became briefly famous. After costs the club is {amount} up, and the local paper got a photograph it will use for years.
news.upSantaGrottoSubj: The grotto did not go to plan
news.upSantaGrotto: The idea was a Christmas grotto in the East Stand concourse. The execution involved a queue that stretched into the car park, a reindeer that was clearly a pony, and a Santa who had to be replaced at short notice for reasons the club will not be commenting on. Down {amount}, and the pony has been asked back.
news.upFilmCrewSubj: A film crew have taken over the ground
news.upFilmCrew: Something with a big budget and a lot of drizzle in it is being shot at {stadium} for a fortnight. The club is {amount} up, catering has never been better, and three academy lads have been paid to stand in the background looking disappointed, which they described afterwards as the easiest money of their lives.
news.upClubhouseSubj: The clubhouse has become the place to be
news.upClubhouse: Somebody put a proper coffee machine in, somebody else started a Thursday quiz, and the clubhouse at {stadium} has quietly turned into the busiest room in the town. Takings are up, the committee are delighted, and a local darts team has asked whether they can move in permanently. {amount} to the good.
news.campRoundSubj: Word from camp: {n} of yours were out there
news.campRound:
{tests} Tests, {n} of your players involved, and this is how the weekend went for them.

{blocks_ll}
news.campRoundV2Subj: Test weekend: how your {n} got on
news.campRoundV2:
The national coaches have sent their reports back: {n} of your players, {tests} Tests between them.

{blocks_ll}
news.campRoundV3Subj: On Test duty: the reports on your {n}
news.campRoundV3:
{tests} Tests this weekend with {n} of your players involved. Here is what the federation staff made of them.

{blocks_ll}
news.campBlockRest: ({n} more of yours in that one)
news.debtOpened: The club is overdrawn by {amount}. The board have asked for a plan to get it back, and they will keep asking.

debtPressure.one: {weeks} week overdrawn, now {amount} down. The boardroom is losing patience faster every month this goes on.
debtPressure.other: {weeks} weeks overdrawn, now {amount} down. The boardroom is losing patience faster every month this goes on.

debtCleared.one: The books balance again after {weeks} week in the red. The board say nothing, which is the compliment.
debtCleared.other: The books balance again after {weeks} weeks in the red. The board say nothing, which is the compliment.

news.grudgeAbove: The table now reads {mine} and {theirs}, in that order. It has not read that way for a while, and the supporters' forum has noticed at once.
news.grudgeBelow: {rival} are above you in the table again - {theirs} to your {mine}. Their supporters have already made the graphic.
news.ledgerFirstAway: That's your first win at {ground}. It took {tries} {tries_k}. The away end will remember the day the run ended.
news.ledgerFirstDerby: Your first {derby} win, against {opp}. Whatever happens now, the town knows you've done it once.
news.ledgerUnbeaten: Ten unbeaten in the league became {n}. Nobody in the building is saying the word out loud.
news.grKidRating: {kid} has found out what a video game thinks of that acceleration and has posted a screenshot with no caption, which on the internet counts as a declaration of war. The developers have replied with a shrug emoji. Three teammates have replied agreeing with the game.
news.grKidRatingSubj: SOCIAL: {kidLast} discovers his own rating and takes it personally
news.staffSacked: {club} have parted company with {role_k} {name}. The club paid {cost} to end his contract; the role is vacant.
news.released: {club} have released {name} ({pos}, {age}) with immediate effect, paying off the remainder of his contract at a cost of {cost}. He is a free agent.

knockFlared.one: Playing through it has cost more than it saved: {name}'s injury flared up in the match, and the physio now has a lay-off of {n} week.
knockFlared.other: Playing through it has cost more than it saved: {name}'s injury flared up in the match, and the physio now has a lay-off of {n} weeks.

news.jokerSigned: {name} ({pos}, {age}) joins on a short-term deal to cover for {hurt}. The wage of {wage} sits outside the salary cap during the cover, and the deal ends when {hurt} is fit again or at the end of the season.
news.jokerEndsFit: {hurt} is fit again, so {name}'s short-term deal as a medical joker is over. {name} leaves with the club's thanks and is now a free agent.
news.jokerEndsGone: The player {name} was covering has left the club, so the medical-joker deal ends. {name} is now a free agent.
news.jokerEndsSeason: The season is over and so is {name}'s medical-joker deal. {name} is now a free agent and can be signed again on ordinary terms.
news.grounds1Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: shorts give way, lineout waits
news.grounds1: A {club} prop reached the front of a lineout on Saturday with his shorts around his knees, having lost a one-sided argument with a breakdown thirty seconds earlier. Unbothered, they called for the ball twice. The referee, less relaxed, stopped the game and sent them to the touchline to be reassembled. The broadcaster showed the sky for eleven seconds.
news.grounds2Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: two home kits, no away kit, one long afternoon
