news.grounds2: The kit van arrived at {other} carrying two full sets of {club} home shirts and no away shirts whatsoever. Since both clubs play in much the same colour, the visitors spent the first half in a borrowed set belonging to the host's third team, complete with a local plumber's name across the chest. Nobody could tell anybody apart, least of all the players.
news.grounds3Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: dog takes the ball, dog keeps the ball
news.grounds3: Play at {club} was held up for three minutes when a supporter's terrier got onto the pitch, took the match ball cleanly off a ruck and declined all offers to give it back. It was eventually traded a roll of strapping tape by the home fly-half, who later described the negotiation as the hardest of the season.
news.grounds4Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: the mud sends off the wrong man
news.grounds4: Conditions at {club} were so bad by the hour mark that the numbers had gone entirely, and the referee sent the wrong prop off for ten minutes over a repeated scrum offence. The right prop, standing beside him, said nothing at all. The review afterwards put it right on paper, which was of limited comfort to the ten minutes.
news.grounds5Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: a lifetime of socks down, finally noticed
news.grounds5: A senior {club} forward has played with socks around the ankles since the age of fifteen, on the grounds that it has always worked. A camera angle on Saturday made this the most discussed thing about the match, which finished 12-9. Asked about it four times since, the answer has been the same each time: they were fine.
news.grounds6Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: bus leaves, winger does not
news.grounds6: The {club} bus completed roughly forty minutes of the journey home from {other} before anyone established that a young winger was still at the service station, where he had gone in for a coffee and come out to an empty car park. He got a lift back with a family who had been at the match and who, by all accounts, had opinions about the second half.
news.grounds7Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: forty kicks, no rugby, one furious internet
news.grounds7: A three-minute passage of {club} and {other} kicking the ball to one another without interruption has been watched several million times this week by people expressing disappointment. It was raining sideways at the time and both sides thought it was going rather well. The clip has been titled "tennis" by everybody except the two coaches.
news.grounds8Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: announcer reads one score rather louder than the other
news.grounds8: The stadium announcer at {club} has been asked to consider his tone after Saturday's heavy home win, in which every home score was delivered at considerable volume and the visitors' single penalty was murmured like a man admitting to a broken window. The away club has written a letter. The home crowd has started a petition to keep him.
news.grounds9Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: pitch invader tackles nobody, ruins everything
news.grounds9: Somebody in a dressing gown got onto the pitch at {club} at the precise moment the home side had an overlap on the right, and stood in the way of it. They appeared to be as surprised as anybody. The move broke down, the scrum came back, and the club has spent the week talking about stewarding rather than the four tries.
news.grounds10Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: pub side challenges a professional squad, sells out
news.grounds10: A pub team near {club} challenged the professional squad to a charity crossbar contest during the international break and, to widespread astonishment, the professionals said yes. Four hundred people came. The pub team won on the last kick, and the money went to the local hospital, so nobody involved is admitting how seriously it was taken.
news.grounds11Subj: AROUND THE GROUNDS: the away kit that launched a thousand opinions
news.grounds11: {club} have unveiled an away shirt that the club describes as a bold reinterpretation of its heritage and that its supporters describe, at length and with imagination, as something else. It has sold out twice. The club has been careful not to say whether that proves the point or disproves it.
news.totySubj: TEAM OF THE YEAR: the fifteen who defined it
news.toty:
The governing body has published its Team of the Year, one player in each shirt, chosen on what the last twelve months actually looked like rather than on reputation.

{rows_ll}
news.totyMineSubj: The Team of the Year is worth money to us
news.totyMine: We have {n} in the Team of the Year: {names}. Replica shirts with those names are selling faster than we can print them, two promoters want an evening with them, and sponsors who ignored us in September are asking what an endorsement costs. Worth {money}, and none of it out of the playing budget.
news.friendlyBooked: {club} will come to {short} on {date}. No gate money worth counting - what it is for is eighty minutes for the academy and the players who have not had a game.
news.islesOfferSubj: An invitation from the four unions
news.islesOffer:
The four unions have written to you jointly. They want you to take the British & Irish Isles XV to {host} this summer: seven provincial games and a three-Test series.

There is no shortlist and no interview. They have chosen, and they are asking. Your assistant takes your national side while you are away.
news.srPredBeat: The pundits said {pred_o} and you finished {act_o}. They owe you an apology.
news.srPredExact: The pundits said {pred_o}, and {act_o} it was. Read like a book.
news.srPredMiss: The pundits said {pred_o} and you finished {act_o}. The phone-ins will be brutal.
news.jobOffered: {club} have made a formal offer. The desk, the squad and a transfer budget of {budget} are yours if you want them, and {stadium} would like an answer.
news.jobDeclined: {manager} has turned {club} down. The board thank him for his time and move to the next name on their list, which is how these things go.
news.jobWithdrawn: {club} waited as long as a board waits, heard nothing, and have appointed somebody else. The offer is off the table.
news.mentorLost_f: With {mentor} gone, {kid} is training alone again. The academy coach will keep an eye on her, but it isn't the same.

wantsTerms_f.one: {player}'s agent has been on the phone: their client is playing out of her skin (avg {avg}) on {wage}/week, and the market rate is well north of that. She has {n} year left, but leave it unresolved and her head will drop - and other clubs will smell it.
wantsTerms_f.other: {player}'s agent has been on the phone: their client is playing out of her skin (avg {avg}) on {wage}/week, and the market rate is well north of that. She has {n} years left, but leave it unresolved and her head will drop - and other clubs will smell it.

news.agentPublic_f: Two months of silence from the club, so the agent has taken it to the papers: "{player} is one of the best-performing players in the league and the club knows our position." Rival clubs will have noticed. Sort a new deal, or brace for bids.
news.becomesMentor_f: The coaches have noticed it in the little things - the extras after training, the way she talks in the huddle. {player} is starting to carry herself like {mentor}.
news.aheadOfSchedule_f: Good news from the treatment table: {player} ({injury_k}) has smashed her rehab targets and is available again this week, earlier than anyone dared hope.
news.wPeaceBrokered_f: The manager got them in a room and shut the door. Both women came out and trained. Nobody is pretending they are friends, but the squad can get on with its week.
news.wBoot1_f: {player} has signed a personal sponsorship with a boot manufacturer. Her locker now contains fourteen boxes of boots and one very smug grin.
news.wAdvert1_f: {player} spent her day off filming a regional car dealership advert. Team-mates have already obtained the script. Training may include dramatic readings.
news.wAdvert2_f: {player} is the new face of a local bathroom showroom. The billboard goes up next month. The dressing room has already ordered a framed print for her locker.
news.wChef1_f: The performance department has brought in {chef_k} for the rest of the season. The senior pros are sceptical. The youngsters are all-in. Someone has already broken the new equipment.
news.wRumour1_f: {buyerName} have sent scouts to {ownerPoss} last three matches - the woman they're watching is {player}.
news.wRumour2_f: Agents claim {buyer} are readying a {fee} bid for {player}. {owner} insist she is going nowhere.
news.wAgent2_f: Six months left on {player}'s deal and her agent has started answering the phone on the first ring. "No comment" has never carried so much comment. Renew her or price her.
news.wAgent3_f: The contract clock is ticking on {player}, and this week her agent was photographed at lunch with two directors of rugby who were not yours. Draw your own conclusions. Everyone else has.
news.grForumExit_f: One unsourced post claiming {star} has "told friends she wants out" has produced four hundred replies, two spin-off threads and a poll. There is no agent, no journalist and no evidence. Page nine is arguing about the stadium car park. One moderator: "Every year. Same thread. Same fella posting it."
news.grSocialClip_f: Two million views and counting for a clip of {star} doing something that should not be physically available to a woman that size. The comments are split between awe and accusations of a smaller pitch. {shortPoss} media team have posted it, deleted it, and posted it again with worse music.
news.grAiGraphic_f: The pre-match player card rendered {star} with an extra finger, a surname spelled two different ways in the same graphic, and a career-tries figure that would make her the leading scorer in the sport's history. The broadcaster has apologised. The screenshot is already a profile picture.
news.grSchoolVisit_f: A local primary asked the {short} academy whether anyone could hand out a reading prize. {kid} arrived early, stayed two hours and signed everything put in front of her including the lectern and one teacher's laptop lid. The video has more views than the club's last three tries combined.
news.grPropGymSubj_f: SOCIAL: {propLast} lifts something she should not have lifted
news.grDrone_f: Somebody flew a drone over a closed session hoping for the team sheet and captured forty minutes of a squad doing a passing drill in complete silence, plus one woman tying a lace for nine of them. The footage has been posted anyway. It has done numbers.
news.grQuiz_f: The media team filmed a light-hearted club history quiz and released it without watching it back. Nobody named the ground's record attendance, one woman guessed the club was founded in 1998, and the captain named a competition that has never existed. It is the club's most watched video of the season.
news.chTale1_f: {prop} shot the round of her life at the team golf day and has already had the scorecard laminated. It is now blu-tacked inside her locker at eye level. The backs have demanded a recount; the referee (the kit man) says the result stands.
news.chTale5_f: At a community visit this week the fastest woman at the club was beaten over 40 metres by a twelve-year-old wearing school shoes. {wing} maintains the start was jumped and has formally requested a rematch "on a proper track, with blocks". The twelve-year-old's PE teacher is considering terms.
news.wWin5_f: A girl in the family stand has started bringing a homemade cardboard trophy. Three straight wins. Her dad keeps apologising to the row behind and nobody minds.
news.wLoseOn3_f: The slump goes on and the woman with the flask in row F has started bringing a book. She has renewed every year since 1987. She will renew again. She would just like a reason.
news.wKid3_f: The stopwatch brigade were out in force again for {clubPoss} {pos} {player}. She is {age}. The women in the stand with clipboards were not there for the tea.
news.wMerc1_f: - and her agent is already dialling
news.wMerc2_f: , and her agent says it loudest
news.wGrumble1_f: Sources say {player} ({pos}, rated among your best) trained away from the main group on Monday. Her camp's message: "She didn't come here to hold tackle bags." Play her, sell her, or watch the mood sour{merc1_k}.
news.wGrumble3_f: The cameras caught {player} watching the warm-up from the bench again, jaw set. A {pos} of her standing does not stay quiet forever{merc3_k}. The dressing room is watching how you handle it.
news.friendly_f: {club} have agreed to a run-out at your place. Minutes for the fringe women, sharpness for the returners - just don't get anyone hurt.
news.ddRoundupFlop_f:
The window is shut. {n} deals crossed the line on the final day{big_k}:
{rows_ll}
23:40 - COLLAPSED: {flop}'s move fell apart at the medical. She stays at {flopClub} - for now.
Back to rugby.
news.keptPlans_f: You told {player} she was in your plans, and the team sheets backed it up. She knocks on your door after training: "You did not have to promise me anything, and you kept it anyway. Thank you, coach." The dressing room has not forgotten the conversation either. Trust like that is worth points.
news.keptMinutes_f: {player} got the minutes you promised her. She finds you in the corridor after the session: "You said I would get my chance and you kept your word. I will not forget that, coach." The academy coach is purring too: "That is how you grow one." The kid would run through a wall for you now.
news.keptDeal_f: {player} has her new deal, just as you said she would. The senior pros noticed: this is a club where a handshake still means something.
news.brokePlans_f: You told {player} she was in your plans {n} weeks ago. She has barely seen the pitch since. The conversation has leaked to the squad, and her agent is already briefing that "the manager's word means nothing at this club."
news.brokeMinutes_f: {player} was promised minutes and got none. She trained with headphones in all week, and the academy coach has stopped defending you in the canteen.
news.brokeDeal_f: {player} is still waiting for the deal you as good as promised her. She held off other offers on your word - now she feels strung along, and the older heads in the squad are watching how this ends.

wcHomeA_f.one: {nationCap_k} are champions of the world, and {names} was in the squad that did it. The shirt goes in a frame; the aura comes back to training with her. Whatever happens for the rest of her career, nobody can take this away.
wcHomeA_f.other: {nationCap_k} are champions of the world, and {names} were in the squad that did it. The shirt goes in a frame; the aura comes back to training with them. Whatever happens for the rest of their careers, nobody can take this away.

wcHomeB_f.one: When the confetti settled on the World Championship final, {names} of {nationThe_k} was under it - your player, world champion. Whatever happens for the rest of her career, nobody can take this away.
wcHomeB_f.other: When the confetti settled on the World Championship final, {names} of {nationThe_k} were under it - your players, world champions. Whatever happens for the rest of their careers, nobody can take this away.

news.guardA_f: A guard of honour at training this week - {player} brought up her {n_o} senior appearance at the weekend. {tail_k}
news.guardB_f: They lined the tunnel for her on Monday morning: {n} senior appearances for {player}, and she shrugged it off like a woman who intends to double it. {tail_k}
news.guardC_f: {player} reached {n} senior appearances at the weekend. The kit man found the old shirts, somebody found the old photographs, and the youngsters learned who she used to be. {tail_k}
news.guardTail300_f: They will name something after her one day.
news.bigOneStarB_f: and {bStar} in the form of her life
news.adsB_f: The broadcaster's trailer dropped this morning: thunder, mud, your crest filling the screen{venue_k}. The squad played it in the team room eleven times. The kit man has ironed everything twice. Finals week does something to a building.
news.retires_f: {player} ({age}) knocks on your door before the press find out: she is retiring at the end of the season. No drama, no demands - she wanted you to hear it from her. The chief scout does not love the {pos} market this year. The academy may have to answer this one.
news.retiresSucc_f: {player} ({age}) knocks on your door before the press find out: she is retiring at the end of the season. No drama, no demands - she wanted you to hear it from her. The chief scout already has the {pos} shirt covered: {succ}. The succession starts now.
news.loanLevel_f: playing every week and doing her job. Their coaches like her; they also quietly think this is her level.
news.loanStar_f: the first name on their team sheet. Their coach says she is running games at that level. Expect a different player back in the summer.
news.loanSteady_f: getting the minutes she went for. Steady rather than spectacular, but every week down there is a week she was not carrying tackle bags here.
news.momTailOurs_f: A proud week for the club and a lift for the woman herself.
news.potyYours_f: She is YOURS. The whole sport just watched your woman collect its biggest prize - enjoy the market circling her, because it starts tomorrow.
news.potyPodium_f: One of yours made the podium. The scouts noticed; so did her agent.
news.lastYearOne_f: Development deals run out at 21, and this season is the last one for {men_l}. Promote her to a professional contract before next summer, or the deal expires and she walks for nothing.
news.releasedOne_f: No professional terms were offered, so at 21 the academy road ends: {men_l} leaves as a free agent. The academy coach clears her locker and starts again with the next intake.
news.hofOne_f: {men_l} retires with numbers that close the argument. {mine_k} Her plaque goes up alongside the immortals.
news.hofYoursOne_f: She finishes as one of yours - a career your club will claim for generations.
news.academyBuzz_f: {heir}, a {age}-year-old {pos}, has joined the academy - and the coaches whisper she has everything {player} had at that age. Handle with care.
news.shirtUp_f: The farewell tour is over. {player} finishes with {apps} appearances for the club, and this morning her shirt went up over the tunnel where every young player will walk under it.
news.intakeDayB_f: A strong group - at least one of these girls should make the first team her own.
news.totsHere_f: She collects the award at the end-of-season dinner to the loudest cheer of the night.
news.totsGone_f: She is not at the club to collect it, which makes the ovation longer, not shorter.
news.loanBack_f: A season of regular rugby has done {player} the world of good. She reports back noticeably sharper.
news.loanEnds_f: The loan is over. {player} heads back to her parent club having grown from the rugby you gave her.
news.lastDanceSubj_f: The last dance: {player} announces her farewell season
news.lastDance_f: {player} ({age}, {pos}) has told the squad this season will be her last. {apps} appearances in the shirt, and one year left to add to them. Her testimonial is set for the pre-season fixture at {stadium} in week {week} - pick her, and give the ground its goodbye.
news.preVoid_f: {player} has been sold before her deal expired, and the move voids the pre-contract she signed with you. Your summer signing is off. The lawyers say there is nothing to be done.
news.preAgreed_f: {player} ({pos}, {age}) has signed a pre-contract with {club}. She sees the season out at {seller}, then joins on a free at terms of {wage}/week. {tail_k}
news.gazumped_f: You left her renewal on the desk too long. {player} has agreed a pre-contract with {to} and will walk for nothing when the season ends. The deal is binding - there is no fee, no negotiation, and no way back.
news.loanIn_f: {player} ({age}, {pos}) joins on loan {len_k}. {parent} cover {share}% of her wage - they want her playing, so play her.
news.loanOut_f: {player} joins {club} for the rest of the season. Regular first-team rugby should accelerate her development - expect her back sharper next summer.
news.recalledFull_f: {player} ({pos}, {age}) is back in the building, match-fit from weekly rugby and visibly improved by the months away. The feeder club are sorry to lose her, which is the best reference there is.
news.huntBid_f:
So it was not paper talk. {club} have made {player} a formal offer of {fee}, comfortably above her valuation, and they have been building to this since the autumn.

You have known it was coming for months. Now you answer it.

transferRequest_f.one: She was told where she stood - {status_k} - and the team sheets say {n} appearance from {played} matches. This morning a formal transfer request landed on your desk. Pick her and she may yet be talked round; leave it and every agent in the league will know she is gettable.
transferRequest_f.other: She was told where she stood - {status_k} - and the team sheets say {n} appearances from {played} matches. This morning a formal transfer request landed on your desk. Pick her and she may yet be talked round; leave it and every agent in the league will know she is gettable.

ledgerSubj_f.one: Game time: {n} player is not getting what she was told
ledgerSubj_f.other: Game time: {n} players are not getting what they were told

ledgerMoreSubj_f.one: Game time: {n} player is not getting what she was told
ledgerMoreSubj_f.other: Game time: {n} players are not getting what they were told

news.ledgerMan_f: {name} ({status_k}): {actual} of the {expected} games she was promised.
news.ledgerWatch_f: {worst} is the one to watch - another month of this and her agent starts dialling.
news.mentGraduates_f: The pairing has run its course. {why_k} {senior} shook her hand after training and the mentoring slot is free for the next one.
news.mentAdopted_f: She carries herself like {senior} now, which was the whole point.
news.mentCeiling_f: The coaches agree there is nothing left on the syllabus. She is the player she was going to be.
news.mentAged_f: At {age} she is a senior pro in her own right, and senior pros do not get lifts to the ground.
news.mentThriving_f: {fit_k}. {reason_k} The academy coach says {kid} has started doing the unglamorous parts without being asked, which is the bit you cannot coach. She is developing faster for it.
news.mentFailing_f: {fit_k}. {reason_k} {kid} is getting very little out of it. Nothing has gone wrong between them; it simply is not working, and the season is long enough for a fresh start to pay.

specialist_f.one: The consultant found a better rehab route for {player}'s {injury_k}. She should be back {n} week earlier than feared.
specialist_f.other: The consultant found a better rehab route for {player}'s {injury_k}. She should be back {n} weeks earlier than feared.

news.slListed_f: has been TRANSFER LISTED by {short}. She can be had cheap - move before someone else does.
news.slExpiring_f: is out of contract this summer. {short} haven't tied her down - a free transfer in the making.
news.slForm_f: is in the form of her life ({form}). Her price is climbing by the week.
news.capFine_f: {club} finished the season {over}/wk over the {cap}/wk salary cap. The league fine the club {fine} and put it on notice: breach it again next season and the punishment is a transfer embargo. Two women can be named marquee and taken out of the calculation, and academy players never counted.
news.adminOther_f: {club} have gone into administration after a season they could not pay for. The league will dock them {n} points, and two senior women have already been released as the administrators cut the wage bill.

postcard_f.one:
{weeksIn} weeks into the brief. "{verdict_k} I will keep looking - about {n} week until I write it all up."

She is properly scouted now: a true reading, not a range.
postcard_f.other:
{weeksIn} weeks into the brief. "{verdict_k} I will keep looking - about {n} weeks until I write it all up."

She is properly scouted now: a true reading, not a range.

news.postcardKeen_f: Watched {player} twice now and I would put my name to her. {age}, {pos_k} {at_k}, and she does the things you cannot teach.
news.postcardMaybe_f: {player} is worth a mention. {age}, {pos_k} {at_k}. Not the answer on her own, but I would not rule her out.
news.scoutReport_f: {months} months, {n} {names_k}, {good} of them he would sign tomorrow. Top of the list: {player}, {age}, {pos_k} {at_k} - {note_k} The full report is in the Transfer Centre, and every woman on it is now properly known to your recruitment staff.
news.noteA1_f: Ready now and she would walk into your XV.
news.noteA2_f: The best in her position I have watched all trip.
news.noteB2_f: A season of proper coaching and she is a starter.
news.noteD2_f: I have seen better, but somebody will pay for her.
news.aLostLine0_f: The scoreline matters less than the minutes. Every one of them went into a young woman who needed them.
news.aLostLine5_f: The coach reckons they were beaten by bigger women, and that bigger women are a matter of time.
news.aTitleMine_f: The A side finish top of the {comp}: {w} wins from {p}, {pf} points scored. Nobody hangs a flag for it, and every coach in the building knows what it means - the pipeline is working, and the women who won it are the ones you will be picking in three years.
news.testimonialDay_f: {stadium} was full for {player}'s testimonial{scored_k}. The gate receipts ({gate}) go to the club at her insistence. One season left in the shirt: make it a good one.
news.testimonialScored_f: - and she scored, because of course she did
news.oldBoyWeWonSubj_f: Old girl {player} crosses against her former club
news.oldBoyWeLostSubj_f: Old girl {player} crosses against her former club
news.oldBoyWeLost_f: Of course it was her. {player} - {apps} appearances in your colours before she left - crossed against her old club and the ground knew it was coming.
news.capMilestone_f: {player} brought up her {n_o} cap for {nationThe_k} this week - a special jersey, a guard of honour, and a proud week around the club.

suspended_f.one: The disciplinary panel has banned {player} for {n} match following her red card. She will be unavailable until the ban is served.
suspended_f.other: The disciplinary panel has banned {player} for {n} matches following her red card. She will be unavailable until the ban is served.

news.debutAcademySubj_f: A debut to tell her grandkids about: {player}
news.debutAcademy_f: {player} ({age}, {pos}) made her first-team debut today - the academy's own, first competitive rugby of her life.{scored_k}{motm_k} Rated {rating} by the press box. The supporters have a new song by Tuesday.
news.debutSigning_f: First competitive appearance in the shirt for {player} ({pos}), and she made it count.{scored_k}{motm_k} Rated {rating} by the press box. The supporters have a new song by Tuesday.
news.debutScored_f: She scored, because new signings who cost the coaching staff sleep always do.
news.debutMotm_f: The sponsors gave her the match award before she had learned everyone's names.
news.mentorSpread_f: {name} has two kids under her wing and she mentioned it after training - politely, but she mentioned it. The extras are shared now, so each girl is learning at about three-quarter speed. Move one of them to another senior pro, or accept the slower pace.
news.trPushA_f: Knocking on the door: {name} is training like a woman who wants the shirt.
news.appealFreeToPlay_f: She is free to play this weekend.
news.heal_f: The specialist retreat has done its work: {n} of the squad walked out with a clean bill of health. Every injury cleared, every woman fresh. Match sharpness is the one thing medicine cannot buy, that comes back on Saturdays.
news.dressingDown_f: Word has leaked that {player} was hauled in front of the coach over her recent form - and didn't take it well. Team-mates say she trained on her own on Tuesday.
news.fanSoldStar_f: {player} has gone to {to} and {club}'s support are not taking it well: the forums say this is a club selling its best and buying nobody, and one supporter has changed her profile picture to a black square. Fan mood down {n}.
news.fanSignedStar_f: {player} is a {club} player. The announcement video has been watched more times than the town has residents, the club shop has sold out of the letters in her name, and a local bakery is doing a limited-edition pastry nobody can describe. Fan mood is up {n}. {rival_k}
news.fanSignedIconSubj_f: THEY'VE ONLY GONE AND SIGNED HER: {player}
news.fanSignedIcon_f: There were people on the streets. Actual people, on a Tuesday. {player} has signed for {club} and the town has lost all proportion: two babies named after the manager, a woman tattooed somewhere she will regret, the club song eleven times before lunch. Fan mood up {n}. {rival_k}
news.fanRivalNamed_f: In the dressing room the mood is more complicated: {rival} has just watched her shirt get a great deal harder to keep.
news.fanRivalNone_f: Nobody in the squad plays where she plays, which is exactly why she was signed.
news.upFilmCrew_f: Something with a big budget and a lot of drizzle in it is being shot at {stadium} for a fortnight. The club is {amount} up, catering has never been better, and three academy kids have been paid to stand in the background looking disappointed, which they described afterwards as the easiest money of their lives.
news.grKidRatingSubj_f: SOCIAL: {kidLast} discovers her own rating and takes it personally
news.released_f: {club} have released {name} ({pos}, {age}) with immediate effect, paying off the remainder of her contract at a cost of {cost}. She is a free agent.
news.grounds4Subj_f: AROUND THE GROUNDS: the mud sends off the wrong woman
news.grounds6_f: The {club} bus completed roughly forty minutes of the journey home from {other} before anyone established that a young winger was still at the service station, where she had gone in for a coffee and come out to an empty car park. She got a lift back with a family who had been at the match and who, by all accounts, had opinions about the second half.
news.friendlyBooked_f: {club} will come to {short} on {date}. No gate money worth counting - what it is for is eighty minutes for the academy and the women who have not had a game.
news.grPunditGem_f: This week's big read calls {kid}, {kidAge}, "the most natural {kidPos} of her generation" and notes that half the league already knows. {short} supporters have spent the day politely asking the columnist to be quiet, delete it, and consider a career in something else. The columnist has replied to eleven of them individually. He is enjoying this enormously.
news.fanSceptic1_w: Never heard of her. Hope the board know something we do not.
news.fanSceptic3_w: I will judge her in May, not August. Prove it on the pitch.
news.fanHopeful2_w: Give her two seasons and a bit of money and see what happens.
news.fanHopeful3_w: She has said the right things. Now let her pick a team.
news.fanPatient1_w: Steady on. New woman, new voice, same old fixture list.
news.fanPatient2_w: The squad is the squad. She can only work with what is in the building.
news.fanPatient3_w: First home game will tell us plenty about how she wants to play.
news.intakeGradeA_w: Her verdict: "There is a special one in this group. I would stake my job on it."
news.intakeGradeB_w: Her verdict: "A strong year. One or two of these will play first-team rugby."
news.intakeGradeC_w: Her verdict: "Honest, coachable kids. Do not expect fireworks."
news.intakeGradeD_w: Her verdict: "A lean year. We will need to buy young instead."
news.intakeGradeE_w: Her verdict: "Between us? Start scouting elsewhere."
news.loanOne_w:
The academy manager files her loan report:
{rows_ll}
news.loanMany_w:
The academy manager files her loan report:
{rows_ll}
news.assHandWin_w: She hands the week back with a win and an insufferable grin.
news.assHandLoss_w: She hands the week back with an apology and a full debrief already on your desk.
news.assHandDraw_w: She hands the week back all square.

bossNotLookingDown_w.one: {boss} has been enjoying herself. "Somebody asked whether I keep an eye on {me}. I keep an eye on the table, and the table says what it says." That is a {n}-point gap she is inviting you to look at. Pin it up somewhere useful.
bossNotLookingDown_w.other: {boss} has been enjoying herself. "Somebody asked whether I keep an eye on {me}. I keep an eye on the table, and the table says what it says." That is a {n}-point gap she is inviting you to look at. Pin it up somewhere useful.

news.bossSize2_w: Asked to name the side she least wants to draw, {boss} went somewhere else entirely. "I would not give anybody that headline." Pressed on {meShort} specifically, she said they were "hard to play against on their day", which is a sentence with a trapdoor in it.
news.bossSize3_w: {boss} says she has stopped watching the table. "It is August somewhere in my head. I will look in April." She then named {mePoss} last three results from memory, in order, which rather gave the game away.
news.bossSize4_w: A short one from {boss} this morning. "{meShort}? Good club, good crowd, good coach." Three compliments and not one word about their rugby. She knows exactly what she is doing.
news.bossTight_w: {club}'s {boss} was asked about you this morning and did not bother pretending. "{who_k}, with everything still to play for. I have watched every game they have played this year. They are good. We are better in the tight five, and I think that is what decides it." {gap_k}, and she has just made it personal.
news.rivalAboveYou_w: {his} against {mine}. {boss} was right, or at least the table says she was, which in this job is the same thing until next May. She will not have forgotten a word of it and neither should you.
news.staffHired_w: {club} have their woman: {name}, {age}, a {badge_k}-badged {role_k}. {fee} compensation, {wage} a week.{out_k}{chem_k}
news.staffClick_w: The staff room approves: she and {other} click - {note_k}.
news.staffClash_w: One cloud on the horizon: she and {other} see the game very differently - {note_k}.
news.badgePass_w: A day of written work and an assessed session in front of examiners who have seen it all, and {name} came through it. Framed certificate, handshake at the training ground, and a better {role_k} than the club had this morning. Her pay rises to {wage} a week.
news.badgeFail_w: The examiners wanted more from {name} on the assessed session. She took it well, asked for the feedback in writing and pinned it above her desk. The {fee} is spent either way, and the next intake will not take her for a month.
news.badgePassAuto_w: Framed certificate, handshake at the training ground, and a better {role_k} than the club had last month. {name} is now {badge_k}-badged, and her pay rises to {wage} a week.
news.badgeFailAuto_w: The examiners want more from {name} on the assessed session. She took it well, asked for the feedback in writing and pinned it above her desk. She can sit it again in four weeks.
news.briefSent_w: {fee} of expenses, a hire car and a brief: {brief_k} {where_k}. {scout} ({badge_k} badge) files her report in {n} weeks. A longer trip sees more rugby and less of it in the rain.
news.scoutReport_w: {months} months, {n} {names_k}, {good} of them she would sign tomorrow. Top of the list: {player}, {age}, {pos_k} {at_k} - {note_k} The full report is in the Transfer Centre, and every man on it is now properly known to your recruitment staff.
news.scoutReport_fw: {months} months, {n} {names_k}, {good} of them she would sign tomorrow. Top of the list: {player}, {age}, {pos_k} {at_k} - {note_k} The full report is in the Transfer Centre, and every woman on it is now properly known to your recruitment staff.
news.aWonLine1_w: She was more pleased with the last twenty minutes than the scoreline, which tells you plenty.
news.aWonLine5_w: She signed off with one line: "That is the standard now."
news.aLostLine2_w: She wants you to know which three kept going at 20 down, because those are the three who will make it.
news.aLostLine4_w: Nobody hid. That was her whole report, and it is the one thing she cares about.
news.staffSacked_w: {club} have parted company with {role_k} {name}. The club paid {cost} to end her contract; the role is vacant.
news.requestGrantedSubj: {player} is free to find a club
news.requestGranted: The request is granted and the name goes on the list. {club} will listen to offers, and every agent in the league already knows it.
news.requestRefused: The request is refused. There is a contract, {club} intend to hold it, and the only way out of this now is through the team sheet.
news.chalCircus: Gloucester's run is over and the roadshow has left town. Sarries are champions of England, and your record against them says it was no accident.
news.chalEaling: Two titles at Trailfinders. A club that was said to have bought its way in has won it on the grass, twice, and there is nothing left to say.
news.chalLicence: Sale finish in the play-off places. The licence is not a question any more - the club belongs there, and the table says so.
news.chalGrudge: Lichfield are champions of the Championship. Passed over when the top flight chose its members, and impossible to ignore now.
news.deputationOne: A delegation of senior players comes to the office and closes the door. Polite and blunt: the room has watched the {a} situation drift, and it wants to know who is in charge. Answer it in the {room_k}, win on Saturday, and the door stops opening.
news.deputationNamedOne: {player} comes to the office and closes the door. Polite and blunt: the room has watched the {a} situation drift, and it wants to know who is in charge. Answer it in the {room_k}, win on Saturday, and the door stops opening.
news.deputationOneSubj: The senior players ask for a meeting
news.expOpened: The hoardings are down and the turnstiles are through it: {stadium} now holds {cap}, {seats} of them new. The waiting list finally moves, and every one of those seats pays its way at the gate.

trainInjury.one: {player} came off the training paddock holding it: {injury_k}. The physio wants a week on it, so he misses the next one.
trainInjury.other: {player} came off the training paddock holding it: {injury_k}. The physio has him down for about {n} weeks, so he is out of your reckoning until then.

news.upSeatsSubj: Twelve hundred seats have gone the colour of weak tea
news.upSeats: Nobody notices a plastic seat until it is the wrong colour, and fifteen summers of sun have taken whole blocks at {stadium} from club red to something closer to salmon. Worse, they have perished with it: three snapped under perfectly ordinary supporters on Saturday. Replacing the affected blocks comes to {amount}.
news.upToiletsSubj: The gents at the Popular End, again
news.upToilets: The half-time queue at {stadium} now forms outside, in the rain, because two thirds of the gents at the Popular End are out of order and one of them has been out of order since a cup tie nobody can date. The plumber's verdict was short and the invoice is not: {amount} for new cisterns, new pipework and a drainage run that he described as "period".
news.upCellarSubj: The cellar cooling packed in on a Friday
news.upCellar: The cooling in the {stadium} cellar failed at some point on Friday night and was discovered on Saturday morning by a steward who described the smell as "warm". Eleven kegs written off, a bar that ran on bottles all afternoon, and a compressor that the engineer says was old when he started. Between the stock and the plant it comes to {amount}.
news.upPowerSubj: The electricity bill has arrived and it is wrong. It is not wrong.
news.upPower: Somebody at {stadium} queried the quarterly electricity bill on the reasonable grounds it could not be right, and the supplier has been through it twice. It is right. Floodlights on a broadcast standard, concourse lighting running around the clock since a timer failed in the autumn, and refrigeration nobody has switched off since the summer. {amount}, payable now.
news.upSurvey: The annual condition survey on {stadium} is in and it is the usual list, which is the problem: barriers, handrails, a run of guttering, the paint on the turnstile block and a fire door that no longer closes on its own. None of it is dramatic and all of it has to be done, which is exactly how a ground gets expensive. {amount}.
news.upConferenceSubj: The conference business had a quarter
news.upConference: Nobody puts a banqueting suite in a rugby ground for the rugby. {stadium} has spent the quarter hosting two trade fairs, a wedding fair, an insurance company's away day and a regional final of something involving spreadsheets. {amount} on the books, and the events manager would like it noted that she has been saying this for years.
news.upToursSubj: Stadium tours are quietly making money
news.upTours: The tour of {stadium} - dressing room, tunnel, a go on the PA, a photograph with the trophy cabinet - has been running all season on a part-timer and a volunteer, and the school bookings have gone through the roof. {amount}, most of it in the shop on the way out, which the retail manager insists was the whole idea.
news.upNamingSubj: The sponsor wants the stand, not the shirt
news.upNaming: A sponsor has been round {stadium} with a tape measure and come back with an offer for the North Stand: their name on it, their colours in the concourse, and a hospitality package that the commercial department has already sold twice over. {amount}, up front. The supporters' trust has views about the name and has been invited to share them at the next forum.
news.boardNo_time: The chairman heard you out and gave you nothing. "We back managers who are winning. Win, and you will find us very supportive." The door is shut for a couple of months.
news.boardNo_funds: The finance director did most of the talking, and most of it was about the current account. There is no more money this season.
news.boardNo_facilities: The board is not minded to pour concrete on this season's evidence. Build a case on the pitch first.
news.boardNo_facilitiesSubj: Board says no: a facilities upgrade
news.boardNo_staff: The backroom stays the size it is. "Get more out of the ones you have" is a sentence every manager hears eventually.
news.boardNo_staffSubj: Board says no: a bigger backroom
news.boardYes_time: The chairman has come out for you publicly, in print, with his name on it. That buys you until the new year whatever the table says - and it is the last thing of its kind you will get.
news.boardYes_funds: The board has found money it did not have last week, which is what winning does to a balance sheet. It is in the transfer budget now.
news.boardYes_facilities: The board will fund the next build itself. Go to Club Infrastructure and ask for it; the bill is theirs, not yours.
news.boardYes_facilitiesSubj: The board will pay for the next build
news.boardYes_staff: The board has ring-fenced money for the backroom. It is not in the transfer budget and it cannot be moved there: it pays for coaches, for the courses that badge them, and for the eight weeks it takes to move one on. Spend it while the goodwill lasts, because boards have short memories about this sort of thing.
news.bondRift: The dressing room has noticed that {a} and {b} have stopped talking to each other. {cause_k} Training has been frosty and the rest of the squad are picking sides. Get the pair in a room, or let the results do the talking.
news.bondMateGone: {player} and {mate} were close, and it shows now that {mate} has gone. Fewer words at training, first out of the door afterwards. A word in the office would not go amiss.
news.bondCliqueSubj: A clique forms in the dressing room
news.bondClique: In the canteen there is now a table for {group_k}, and nobody else sits at it. The group feel the team sheet has favourites and they are not among them: {names_l} and the rest. Their tally of starts this season: {n}. Make room for that group, or talk to them, before it hardens.
news.bondCliqueEnds: The table for {group_k} has broken up. The team sheets have been kinder to them lately, and the dressing room is one room again.

comm.oppCoachNamed: {coach} has done his homework: {team} are set up specifically for {pattern_k}. Change the picture, or play through the plan.
comm.oppCoach: The opposition coach has done his homework: {team} are set up specifically for {pattern_k}. Change the picture, or play through the plan.
comm.koFinalDayGate: FINAL DAY at {venue}. {att} inside and the noise rolling around {city} - two sets of supporters, one trophy. Kick-off!
comm.koFinalDay: FINAL DAY at {venue}. A full house and the noise rolling around {city} - two sets of supporters, one trophy. Kick-off!
comm.koDerbyGate: {derby}! {att} packed in and making an almighty noise. Kick-off!
comm.koDerby: {derby}! The crowd is making an almighty noise. Kick-off!
comm.koGrudge: Bad blood in the air - {reason_k}, and nobody here has forgotten it. Kick-off!
comm.koWind: A swirling wind will test the kickers.
comm.koSnow: Snow flurries - proper old-school rugby weather.
comm.uncontested: The referee has ordered UNCONTESTED SCRUMS - {team} cannot cover all three front-row positions. No shove, no scrum penalties, and every set piece is a formality.
comm.crowdBouncing: The ground is absolutely bouncing - the supporters are in full voice before a ball is kicked.
comm.crowdFlat: A flat, edgy atmosphere. The crowd is waiting to be given a reason.
comm.testimonial: {player}'s testimonial. He leads the teams out with his kids at his side, the ground on its feet, scarves above every head. Then the whistle blows and it is a rugby match again.
comm.oldBoy: A familiar face out there: {player} lines up against {oldClub}, where he made {n} appearances. {tail_k}
comm.oldBoyKnowsThem: He knows this opposition inside out.
comm.oldBoyPolite: A polite reception from the home crowd - for now.
comm.milestoneApps: A milestone afternoon: {player} makes career appearance number {n}. The tunnel applauds him out; the scoreboard will not care.
comm.try1: TRY! {player} crashes over from close range!
comm.try2: TRY! {player} finishes superbly in the corner!
comm.try4: TRY! {player} powers over off the back of the maul!
comm.try5: TRY! {player} steps inside and dives under the posts!
comm.try6: TRY! Sweeping move, and {player} applies the finish!
comm.try7: TRY! Quick tap by {player} catches the defence napping!
comm.try8: TRY! {player} gathers a clever grubber and touches down!
comm.try9: TRY! {player} arcs outside his man and won't be caught!
comm.try10: TRY! {player} picks from the base and burrows over!
comm.try11: TRY! A monstrous fend from {player} and he strolls in!
comm.try12: TRY! {player} takes the offload one-handed and finishes!
comm.try13: TRY! Fifty-metre intercept - {player} all the way!
comm.try15: TRY! Pick-and-go, pick-and-go, and {player} forces it down!
comm.try16: TRY! {player} hits a scything line off the shoulder - untouched!
comm.try17: TRY! The wraparound sends {player} through the front door!
comm.try18: TRY! {player} bumps off three tacklers on his way to the line!
comm.try19: TRY! {player} shows and goes - nobody within five metres of him!
comm.try20: TRY! Eight phases of patience, and {player} finds the shortest of short sides!
comm.try21: TRY! {player} straightens, sits the last man down and strolls under the sticks!
comm.try22: TRY! The blindside wing comes off his line and it is {player} who finishes it!
comm.try23: TRY! {player} takes it flat and hits the line like a train - no stopping that!
comm.try24: TRY! Turnover ball, three passes, and {player} is away - breathless rugby!
comm.try25: TRY! {player} reaches through the tackle and plants it one-handed - the TMO checks and it is GOOD!
comm.try26: TRY! A no-look pass sends {player} in at the flag - cheek and class in one movement!
comm.tryWet1: TRY! {player} follows a slithering kick through and wins the race!
comm.tryWet2: TRY! The greasy ball squirts loose and {player} pounces!
comm.tryWet3: TRY! {player} aquaplanes over in the corner - the crowd doesn't care!
comm.tryWet4: TRY! {player} surfs a puddle over the line - filthy conditions, beautiful result!
comm.tryWet5: TRY! The maul splashes over and {player} emerges from the swamp with the ball!
comm.tryDerby1: TRY! {player} scores - and cups an ear to the away end! Bedlam!
comm.tryDerby2: TRY! {player} settles a hundred pub arguments with that one!
comm.tryDerby3: TRY! {player} through a wall of bodies - this derby has everything!
comm.tryDerby4: TRY! {player} scores in front of the travelling fans and just stands there, arms wide!
comm.tryDerby5: TRY! The town will be unbearable for a week - {player} has scored in the derby!
comm.pen2: {player} makes no mistake from the tee.
comm.pen3: {player} strikes it true - three more points.
comm.pen5: {player} takes his time... and drills it.
comm.pen6: No radar needed - {player} splits them from 45 metres.
comm.pen7: {player} scrapes it over off the left post. They all count.
comm.pen8: Ice in the veins: {player} silences the whistlers.
comm.penTouchOwnHalf: {team} are out of range in their own half, so the penalty goes to touch for the lineout.
comm.pen9: {player} thumps it over from just inside their half - the big boot pays the bills.
comm.pen10: A horrible angle, and {player} makes it look like a warm-up.
comm.pen11: {player} wipes the mud off the ball, wipes the rain off his face, and nails it.
comm.con4: {player} strokes the conversion straight through the middle.
comm.con6: {player} bends it home against the breeze.
comm.con7: {player} barely looks at it. Over. Next job.
comm.con8: From the chalk of the touchline, {player} draws it inside the far post. Kicking coaches will replay that one.
comm.flavGrass1: {player} wins a scrappy one at the back of a collapsing maul - proper National 1 rugby, this.
comm.flavGrass2: A dog has briefly joined the {team} defensive line. Play carries on regardless.
comm.flavGrass3: {player} slips in the mud where the winter pitch never quite recovers. The crowd, all four hundred of them, enjoy that.
comm.flavGrass4: Huge cheer from the clubhouse balcony as {player} flattens his man. Someone rings the bell.
comm.flavGrass5: {team} work it through nine phases - patient stuff for this level, and the tea hut has gone quiet.
comm.flavGrass6: {player}, a schoolteacher on Monday mornings, sends the fly-half the wrong way. Class dismissed.
comm.flavGrass7: The touch judge is a club volunteer and takes a moment to find his flag. {team} tap and go.
comm.flavGrass8: {player} charges down the clearance! The ball ricochets off the beer tent guy-rope and stays in.
comm.flavPac1: {player} throws the wildest offload you'll see all year - and it sticks! {team} pour forward.
comm.flavPac2: {player} takes the ball at full tilt and goes straight through the first tackle. A rampaging carry.
comm.flavPac3: Footwork from {player} that ought to be illegal - three defenders grasp at air.
comm.flavPac4: {team} run it from their own line and the whole side goes with them. The crowd loves every metre.
comm.flavPac5: A hit from {player} you can hear from the back row of the stand. The ball carrier is going nowhere.
comm.flavPac6: One-handed take above his head from {player}, under pressure, in traffic. No notes.
comm.flav1: Big carry from {player} takes {team} into the 22.
comm.flav3: Turnover! {player} wins the breakdown battle for {team}.
comm.flav4: Monster scrum from the {team} pack - penalty advantage.
comm.flav5: {player} claims the high ball under pressure.
comm.flav6: Rolling maul from {team} eats up twenty metres.
comm.flav7: {player} clears the lines with a booming touch-finder.
comm.flav8: Thunderous hit by {player} - the crowd roars.
comm.flav9: {player} steals the lineout - {team} ball against the throw!
comm.flav10: Grubber in behind from {player}; the {team} chase is ferocious.
comm.flav11: {player} slips the tackle and {team} are suddenly on the front foot.
comm.flav12: Choke tackle! {player} holds him up and it's a {team} scrum.
comm.flav13: {player} puts in a 50:22! What a strike - {team} lineout deep in the corner.
comm.flav14: Offload of the season from {player} - {team} swarm forward.
comm.flav15: The {team} defence blitzes and {player} smashes the carrier behind the gain line.
comm.flav16: {player} is everywhere - third jackal attempt in ten minutes for {team}.
comm.flav17: Cross-field kick... {player} climbs highest but it goes to ground. Scrappy stuff.
comm.flav18: {player} takes a quick lineout - the ref waves play on and {team} counter.
comm.flav19: Show-and-go from {player} splits the seam - {team} are in behind!
comm.flav20: {player} wins the aerial duel and {team} have a platform at last.
comm.flav21: The {team} scrum inches forward... and forward... the ref's arm comes out.
comm.flav22: {player} throws a cut-out pass that misses three men - vision, that.
comm.flav23: A try-saver from {player}! Ankle-tapped a metre from the corner flag.
comm.flav24: {player} carries three defenders five metres. The {team} crowd stands to applaud a carry.
comm.flav25: Miscommunication in midfield and {player} pounces on the loose ball for {team}.
comm.flav26: {player} shapes to drop a goal... dummies... and {team} keep it alive!
comm.flavWet1: The rain hammers down as {player} trudges to another {team} scrum.
comm.flavWet2: Knock-on! The soap-bar ball squirts out of {player}'s grasp.
comm.flavWet3: Box kick from {player} disappears into the murk - {team} chase hard.
comm.flavWet4: Mud everywhere. {player}'s number is barely readable now.
comm.flavWet5: {player} calls for the high ball, loses it in the floodlights and the rain. {team} scramble.
comm.flavWet6: The {team} forwards would rather be nowhere else - {player} leads another wallow at the ruck.
comm.flavWind1: {player}'s clearance hangs in the gale and barely makes ten metres.
comm.flavWind2: The wind grabs the restart - {player} does well to gather for {team}.
comm.flavWind3: {player} aims for the corner and the gale carries it dead. Kicking into a hurricane out there.
comm.flavWind4: A {team} pass sails on the wind and {player} has to climb for it two metres off course.
comm.flavDerby1: A scuffle after the whistle! {player} in the middle of it - the ref calls the captains.
comm.flavDerby2: The noise is deafening every time {player} touches it for {team}.
comm.flavDerby3: Derby rugby: {player} launched into the tackle a heartbeat late. The crowd howls.
comm.flavDerby4: A {team} clearance goes straight into the away end, who keep the ball. The ref sighs.
comm.flavDerby5: {player} and his opposite number exchange words at the lineout. Neither is discussing the weather.
comm.tired1: {player} has his hands on his knees - the tank is emptying.
comm.tired3: {player} takes an age to get up from that ruck. The bench is warming up.
comm.tired4: Cramp for {player} - he waves away the physio, but the legs have gone.
comm.chargeDown1: Charged down! {player} gets a hand to the kick from {kicker}!
comm.chargeDown2: {kicker} takes too long over the clearance and {player} smothers it!
comm.chargeDown3: CHARGE-DOWN! {player} flies off the line and blocks the kick from {kicker}!
comm.chargeDown4: {player} throws a body in front of the kick from {kicker} and it cannons back!
comm.chargeDown5: Blocked! {player} reads the exit kick from {kicker} and gets there first. The ball is loose!
comm.tryCharge1: TRY! {player} charged it down and wins the race to touch it down!
comm.tryCharge2: TRY! The ball bounces kindly and {player} falls on it over the line!
comm.tryCharge3: TRY! A charge-down try: {player} is first to the loose ball in-goal!
comm.tryCharge4: TRY! From the block to the grounding in three strides: {player} scores off the charge-down!
comm.chargeLineout1: It squirts off into touch. {team} keep the throw, but they have lost ground.
comm.chargeLineout2: The ricochet runs into touch. Lineout {team}, and they are under pressure.

comm.chargeScrum2: Bodies everywhere and the ball is trapped. The referee gives the scrum to {team}.
comm.chargeScrum3: {opp} knock it on as they try to tidy up. Scrum to {team}.
comm.chargeRegather1: {player} gathers the ricochet and {team} are suddenly on the attack!
comm.chargeRegather2: It bounces straight back to {player}. {team} have the ball in a great position.
comm.chargeRegather3: {player} regathers on the run and {team} pour through in support.

comm.chargeSafe2: {team} get there first and fall on it. A let-off.
comm.chargeSafe3: Heart in mouth for {team}, but the loose ball runs back to one of their own.
comm.kickExit1: {player} clears the lines from inside the 22 with a long touch-finder.
comm.kickExit2: Under pressure in their own 22, {team} look to {player}, and the kick goes long.
comm.kickExit3: {player} gets the exit kick away and {team} can breathe again.
comm.kickExit4: The clearance from {player} finds touch. Job done for now.
comm.kickExit5: {player} kicks it out from behind the 22. Lineout {opp}, but the pressure is off.
comm.kickExit6: {team} get out of their own 22 the simple way: {player} puts boot to ball.
comm.kickExit7: A nervy moment in the {team} 22, but {player} finds touch.
comm.kickBox1: Box kick from {player}, high and hanging.
comm.kickBox2: {player} puts up the box kick and the {team} chase is quick.
comm.kickBox3: {player} goes to the box again. {team} want this contested.
comm.kickBox4: Another box kick from {player}. The {opp} back three settle under it.
comm.kickBox5: {player} kicks from the base of the ruck, and it is a good contestable height.
comm.kickBox6: The box kick from {player} is a little long, and {opp} gather it comfortably.
comm.kickBox7: {player} box-kicks towards the touchline and {team} chase it up.
comm.kickTouch1: {player} finds touch with a raking kick. Lineout {opp}.
comm.kickTouch2: {player} kicks for touch and gains good ground for {team}.
comm.kickTouch3: A long touch-finder from {player}. {team} are happy to play for territory.
comm.kickTouch4: {player} bounces it into touch. Good kick, lineout {opp}.
comm.kickTouch5: {player} rolls it into touch. Tidy from {team}.
comm.kickTouch6: {team} kick for position: {player} finds the touchline.
comm.kickLong1: {player} kicks long downfield and {team} chase in a line.
comm.kickLong2: Long kick from {player}. The kick-chase from {team} is well organised.
comm.kickLong3: {player} turns the {opp} back three with a kick into space.
comm.kickLong4: {team} kick it away and trust the defence: {player} goes long.
comm.kickLong5: A big spiral from {player} sends {opp} back towards their own line.
comm.kickLong6: {player} kicks to the corner of the field. {opp} have to turn and run back.
comm.kickUp1: {player} puts up a high ball for the chasers.
comm.kickUp2: Up and under from {player}! {team} contest in the air.
comm.kickUp3: {player} hoists it, and there is a real contest for the catch.
comm.kickUp4: A bomb from {player}, and the {opp} full-back has to stand under it.
comm.kickUp5: {player} chips over the top, looking for the bounce.
comm.kickUp6: {team} go to the air: a high, hanging kick from {player}.
comm.kickPin1: {player} grubbers into the in-goal. {opp} have to scramble.
comm.kickPin2: A clever little kick in behind from {player}. {opp} touch it down for the drop-out.
comm.kickPin3: {player} kicks for the corner and pins {opp} back on their own line.
comm.kickPin4: {player} tries the grubber through, but it runs dead.
comm.kickPin5: A cross-field kick from {player} towards the wing, and it is batted away.
comm.kickPin6: {player} chips into the 22, and {opp} gather it under pressure.
comm.kickField1: {player} takes it cleanly and runs it back.
comm.kickField2: Safe hands from {player} under the high ball.
comm.kickField3: {player} fields it and returns the kick.
comm.kickField4: {player} claims it and {team} set up to counter.
comm.kickField5: {player} makes the catch with the chasers arriving.
comm.kickField6: {player} catches it and sets off on the counter-attack.
comm.kickField7: {player} gathers and finds touch in return.
comm.pbpDeep1: {team} run it from deep, {player} carrying out of the 22.
comm.pbpDeep2: {player} takes it up from inside their own 22. Hard yards for {team}.
comm.pbpDeep3: {team} keep ball in hand in their own 22. Brave.
comm.pbpDeep4: {player} steps the first defender and {team} are out of trouble for now.
comm.pbpDeep5: {team} try to play their way out. {player} makes a few metres.
comm.pbpDeep6: Pinned back, {team} move it through the hands, and {player} gets them going.
comm.pbpMid1: {player} carries hard over the gain line.
comm.pbpMid2: {team} go wide through the hands, and {player} is stopped near the touchline.
comm.pbpMid3: {player} takes the pass flat and runs into contact.
comm.pbpMid4: A crash ball from {player} in midfield.
comm.pbpMid5: {team} play off nine. {player} picks and drives.
comm.pbpMid6: {player} makes a few metres through the tackle.
comm.pbpMid7: The {team} forwards take it up one out: {player} leads the charge.
comm.pbpMid8: {player} beats the first defender, but the second closes in.
comm.pbpMid9: Good hands from {team}, and {player} finds half a gap.
comm.pbpMid10: {player} runs a decoy line and {team} switch the play.
comm.pbpMid11: {team} build patiently through the middle. {player} with the carry.
comm.pbpMid12: An offload from {player} keeps the move alive for {team}.
comm.pbpRed1: {team} are five metres out. {player} picks and goes.
comm.pbpRed2: {player} is stopped just short of the line.
comm.pbpRed3: Pick-and-go from {team}, inching towards the line.
comm.pbpRed4: {player} drives for the line. The {opp} defence holds, just.
comm.pbpRed5: {team} hammer away at the {opp} line. {player} again.
comm.pbpRed6: {player} goes low and hard and is stopped a metre short.
comm.pbpRed7: {team} are camped on the {opp} line. {player} takes it into contact.
comm.pbpRed8: {player} tries to squeeze through a gap by the posts. Not quite.
comm.pbpRed9: The {team} forwards keep it tight. {player} makes another metre.
comm.pbpRed10: {player} carries into a wall of {opp} shirts.
comm.pbpRuck1: Quick ball from the ruck for {team}. {player} cleared it out well.
comm.pbpRuck2: {player} is first to the breakdown and secures the ball.
comm.pbpRuck3: Slow ball for {team}: {opp} are making a nuisance of themselves at the ruck.
comm.pbpRuck4: {player} hits the ruck hard and {team} recycle quickly.
comm.pbpRuck5: The referee has a word with both sides about the breakdown.
comm.pbpRuck6: {team} protect the ball well at the ruck. {player} over the top.
comm.pbpRuck7: {player} has to scrap for the ball on the floor, but {team} keep it.
comm.pbpRuck8: A long look at the ruck from the referee, and {team} get the ball away.
comm.pbpRuck9: {player} blows the {opp} jackal off the ball.
comm.pbpRuck10: {player} latches on and the {team} pack drive through the breakdown.
comm.pbpPhases2: {team} are through {n} phases, looking for the gap.
comm.pbpPhases4: {team} keep the ball through {n} phases. The {opp} defence is stretched.
comm.pbpPhases5: Phase {n} for {team}, and still no way through.
comm.pbpWet1: {player} juggles the wet ball but holds on.
comm.pbpWet2: The ball is like a bar of soap. {player} does well to keep it.
comm.pbpWet3: {team} keep it tight in the wet. {player} carries.
comm.pbpWet4: {player} slips as the pass arrives, and {team} regroup.
comm.pbpWet5: Heavy going in these conditions. {player} takes it up again.
comm.defSet2: Good line speed from {team}. {opp} are driven back.
comm.defSet3: {team} defend in numbers and the attack runs out of room.
comm.defSet4: The {team} blitz forces {opp} to go backwards.
comm.defSet5: {team} scramble well and snuff out the danger.
comm.defSet6: {opp} cannot find a way through the {team} defence.
comm.defSet7: A double tackle from {team}, and {opp} lose momentum.
comm.defSet8: {team} drift across and push the attack towards the touchline.
comm.defSet9: Solid work from the {team} defence. Nothing given away.
comm.defHit1: Big tackle from {player}, straight back where the carrier came from.
comm.defHit3: {player} chops the carrier down at the ankles.
comm.defHit4: A great tackle from {player}, and straight back into the line.
comm.defHit5: {player} puts in another tackle. Tireless work.
comm.defHit6: {player} comes up fast and stops the carrier behind the gain line.
comm.defHit7: A textbook tackle from {player}, low and hard.
comm.defHit8: {player} wraps up the ball carrier and the move dies.
comm.lineout1: Lineout to {team}. {player} takes it at the front.
comm.lineout2: {team} win their own lineout, {player} at the tail.
comm.lineout3: {player} is lifted high and takes a clean catch for {team}.
comm.lineout4: Quick throw from {team} to {player} in the middle, and off the top.
comm.lineout5: {team} set a maul from the lineout. {player} at the back of it.
comm.lineout6: The {team} throw is slightly overcooked, but {player} tidies it up.
comm.lineout7: {player} rises highest at the lineout for {team}.
comm.lineout8: {opp} compete in the air, but {player} holds on for {team}.
comm.lineout9: {team} go short at the lineout, {player} with the catch.
comm.lineout10: Clean lineout ball for {team}. {player} delivers it to the scrum-half.
comm.scrum1: Scrum to {team}. Set, and away it goes.
comm.scrum2: The {team} scrum goes forward and the ball comes back quickly.
comm.scrum3: Scrum {team}. It wheels a little, but the ball is out.
comm.scrum4: A solid scrum from {team}, and the backs have front-foot ball.
comm.scrum5: The scrum goes down and the referee resets it. {team} to feed again.
comm.scrum6: {team} get a shove on at the scrum.
comm.scrum7: {opp} put pressure on the {team} put-in, but the ball comes out.
comm.scrum8: Scrum to {team} after a knock-on in midfield.
comm.scrum9: A steady scrum. {team} go blind off the back.
comm.scrum10: Both packs hold firm at the scrum, and {team} use the ball.
comm.restart2: {player} kicks off short, and {team} compete for it.
comm.restart3: {team} restart. {player} sends it high to the forwards.
comm.restart4: {player} hangs the restart up, and {opp} take it cleanly.
comm.restart5: The restart from {player} goes deep. {opp} will clear.
comm.restart7: {player} restarts to the left and {team} chase hard.
comm.restart8: {player} kicks off to the {opp} pod, and they secure it.
comm.restart9: {team} regroup under the posts, and {player} gets the game going again.
comm.restart10: A good restart from {player}, and the pressure is straight back on {opp}.
comm.terrCamped2: All the territory is with {team} at the moment.
comm.terrCamped3: {opp} cannot get out of their own end.
comm.terrCamped5: The game is being played deep in {opp} territory. {team} are turning the screw.
comm.terrMiddle1: A tight, even passage of play between the 22s.
comm.terrMiddle2: Neither side can get on top. {home} and {away} trade blows in midfield.
comm.terrMiddle3: The play swings back and forth around halfway.
comm.terrMiddle4: Plenty of kicking between {home} and {away}, and nobody gains much ground.
comm.terrMiddle5: It is an arm-wrestle in midfield.
comm.lateChase1: {team} have ten minutes to save this.
comm.lateChase2: The clock is against {team}. They need a score.
comm.lateHold1: {team} are trying to see this out.
comm.lateHold2: {team} slow everything down. Every second counts.
comm.lateHold3: Can {team} hold on? The minutes tick by.
comm.lateHold4: {team} kick for the corners and play the clock.
comm.lateLevel1: All square as the clock runs down. One score could decide this.
comm.lateLevel2: {home} and {away} are level. Who blinks first?
comm.lateLevel3: Nothing between {home} and {away}, and time is running out.
comm.tmoReview1: {team} are over the line - but the referee wants the TMO to check the grounding.
comm.tmoReview2: {team} dot it down, but the referee goes upstairs: was there a knock-on in the build-up?
comm.tmoReview3: {team} score in the corner - or do they? The TMO is checking the final pass.
comm.tmoReview4: {team} go over by the flag, and the referee asks the TMO about the touchline.
